{"parentUuid":"661e46a6-c516-454e-9385-54d8803683cf","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_anrqas5df6h9k3e49emut22s","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp10/b/src/merkle.rs","content":"//! Merkle 树：分块、域分离哈希、奇数提升、范围证明与验证。\n//!\n//! # 哈希规范（所有参与方必须一致）\n//!\n//! - 底层哈希：SHA-256，输出 32 字节。\n//! - **空文件**（0 个块）的根固定为 `SHA-256(\"MERKLE_EMPTY_ROOT_v1\" || u64-le(chunk_size))`。\n//! - **叶节点**（对应一个数据块）：`SHA-256(0x00 || u64-le(chunk_index) || u64-le(chunk_size) || chunk_bytes)`。\n//!   块序号绑定进叶摘要，防止块在证明中被重排。\n//! - **内部节点**：\n//!   - 普通双亲：`SHA-256(0x01 || u64-le(level) || left_hash || right_hash)`，level 从 1 开始（level0 为叶层）。\n//!   - **奇数提升**：某层节点数为奇数时，最后一个节点不复制、不哈希，原样提升到上一层同位置。\n//! - 块大小是协议参数（默认 4096），参与叶/空根哈希，防止跨参数混用。\n//!\n//! 域前缀（0x00 / 0x01）使叶与内部节点不可能互相伪造；level 绑定使同值在不同层产生不同摘要。\n\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\nuse sha2::{Digest, Sha256};\n\n/// 默认块大小（字节）。\npub const DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE: u64 = 4096;\n\n/// SHA-256 摘要。\npub type Hash32 = [u8; 32];\n\n/// 计算文件需要的块数。空文件为 0，否则 `ceil(len / chunk_size)`。\npub fn chunk_count(file_len: u64, chunk_size: u64) -> u64 {\n    assert!(chunk_size > 0, \"chunk_size must be > 0\");\n    file_len.div_ceil(chunk_size)\n}\n\n/// 块 `index` 在文件中的字节偏移。\npub fn chunk_offset(index: u64, chunk_size: u64) -> u64 {\n    index.checked_mul(chunk_size).expect(\"offset overflow\")\n}\n\nfn hash_empty_root(chunk_size: u64) -> Hash32 {\n    let mut h = Sha256::new();\n    h.update(b\"MERKLE_EMPTY_ROOT_v1\");\n    h.update(chunk_size.to_le_bytes());\n    h.finalize().into()\n}\n\n/// 计算叶节点摘要：`SHA-256(0x00 || u64-le(index) || u64-le(chunk_size) || bytes)`。\npub fn hash_leaf(index: u64, chunk_size: u64, bytes: &[u8]) -> Hash32 {\n    let mut h = Sha256::new();\n    h.update([0x00u8]);\n    h.update(index.to_le_bytes());\n    h.update(chunk_size.to_le_bytes());\n    h.update(bytes);\n    h.finalize().into()\n}\n\n/// 计算内部双亲摘要：`SHA-256(0x01 || u64-le(level) || left || right)`。\npub fn hash_pair(level: u64, left: &Hash32, right: &Hash32) -> Hash32 {\n    let mut h = Sha256::new();\n    h.update([0x01u8]);\n    h.update(level.to_le_bytes());\n    h.update(left);\n    h.update(right);\n    h.finalize().into()\n}\n\n/// 一层节点的奇偶归约：两两哈希，奇数个时末尾节点原样提升。\n///\n/// 返回新一层（长度 `ceil(n/2)`）。\npub fn reduce_level(level_no: u64, nodes: &[Hash32]) -> Vec<Hash32> {\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(nodes.len().div_ceil(2));\n    let mut i = 0;\n    while i + 1 < nodes.len() {\n        out.push(hash_pair(level_no, &nodes[i], &nodes[i + 1]));\n        i += 2;\n    }\n    if i < nodes.len() {\n        // 奇数提升：最后一个节点不哈希直接上移\n        out.push(nodes[i]);\n    }\n    out\n}\n\n/// 由叶层自底向上构建完整树，返回各层；`levels[0]` 为叶层。\npub fn build_levels(leaves: &[Hash32]) -> Vec<Vec<Hash32>> {\n    let mut levels = Vec::new();\n    levels.push(leaves.to_vec());\n    let mut level_no = 1u64;\n    while levels.last().unwrap().len() > 1 {\n        let next = reduce_level(level_no, levels.last().unwrap());\n        levels.push(next);\n        level_no += 1;\n    }\n    levels\n}\n\n/// 由所有叶哈希求根。空树（无块）使用 [`hash_empty_root`]。\npub fn root_from_leaves(leaves: &[Hash32], chunk_size: u64) -> Hash32 {\n    if leaves.is_empty() {\n        return hash_empty_root(chunk_size);\n    }\n    let levels = build_levels(leaves);\n    levels.last().unwrap()[0]\n}\n\n/// 由全部块数据全量重建根（验收基线：与增量更新后的根比较）。\npub fn rebuild_root_from_chunks(chunks: &[Vec<u8>], chunk_size: u64) -> Hash32 {\n    let leaves: Vec<Hash32> = chunks\n        .iter()\n        .enumerate()\n        .map(|(i, c)| hash_leaf(i as u64, chunk_size, c))\n        .collect();\n    root_from_leaves(&leaves, chunk_size)\n}\n\n/// 按块大小切分一段文件字节。\npub fn split_chunks(data: &[u8], chunk_size: u64) -> Vec<Vec<u8>> {\n    let cs = chunk_size as usize;\n    if data.is_empty() {\n        return Vec::new();\n    }\n    let n = data.len().div_ceil(cs);\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(n);\n    for i in 0..n {\n        let end = (i * cs + cs).min(data.len());\n        out.push(data[i * cs..end].to_vec());\n    }\n    out\n}\n\n/// 把叶层上的若干修改（块序号 -> 新叶哈希）增量合并进既有各层。\n///\n/// 仅重算受影响路径：每层只对“脏”双亲调用 [`hash_pair`]；奇数提升位与未涉及的子树保持不动。\n/// 返回新的各层。\npub fn update_levels(prev: &[Vec<Hash32>], changes: &[(u64, Hash32)]) -> Vec<Vec<Hash32>> {\n    let mut levels: Vec<Vec<Hash32>> = prev.to_vec();\n    if levels.is_empty() {\n        return levels;\n    }\n    let mut dirty: Vec<(u64, Hash32)> = changes.to_vec();\n    for level_no in 1u64..(levels.len() as u64) {\n        let width = levels[(level_no - 1) as usize].len();\n        for &(idx, h) in &dirty {\n            levels[(level_no - 1) as usize][idx as usize] = h;\n        }\n        let mut next_dirty = Vec::with_capacity(dirty.len());\n        for (idx, _) in dirty.drain(..) {\n            let parent = idx / 2;\n            if idx % 2 == 1 {\n                // 脏节点是右孩子，且它是该层最后一个（奇数提升），直接把新值提升\n                if idx as usize == width - 1 {\n                    next_dirty.push((parent, levels[(level_no - 1) as usize][idx as usize]));\n                    continue;\n                }\n                let l = levels[(level_no - 1) as usize][(idx - 1) as usize];\n                let r = levels[(level_no - 1) as usize][idx as usize];\n                next_dirty.push((parent, hash_pair(level_no, &l, &r)));\n            } else {\n                let l = levels[(level_no - 1) as usize][idx as usize];\n                if idx as usize + 1 < width {\n                    let r = levels[(level_no - 1) as usize][(idx + 1) as usize];\n                    next_dirty.push((parent, hash_pair(level_no, &l, &r)));\n                } else {\n                    // 左孩子但已是层末（奇数提升）\n                    next_dirty.push((parent, l));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        // 同一双亲可能因两个孩子都脏而被压入两次，去重保最后值\n        next_dirty.sort_by_key(|(i, _)| *i);\n        next_dirty.dedup_by(|a, b| {\n            if a.0 == b.0 {\n                // 保留后写入的（即基于更完整脏状态计算的）值\n                b.1 = a.1;\n                true\n            } else {\n                false\n            }\n        });\n        for &(idx, h) in &next_dirty {\n            levels[level_no as usize][idx as usize] = h;\n        }\n        dirty = next_dirty;\n    }\n    levels\n}\n\n/// 范围证明中的一层“邻居”。每一层至多两个哈希：\n///\n/// - `left`：当前区间左侧相邻兄弟（当区间左边界是父节点右孩子时存在）\n/// - `right`：当前区间右侧相邻兄弟（当区间右边界是父节点左孩子且未落在提升位时存在）\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct ProofStep {\n    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\", with = \"opt_hash_hex\")]\n    pub left: Option<Hash32>,\n    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\", with = \"opt_hash_hex\")]\n    pub right: Option<Hash32>,\n}\n\n/// 一个连续块区间 `[start, end)` 的 Merkle 包含证明。\n///\n/// 证明自带块数据（仅区间内块，**不读取完整文件**），验证者逐块重算叶哈希后自底向上校验到根。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct RangeProof {\n    /// 协议块大小（字节）。\n    pub chunk_size: u64,\n    /// 文件总长度（字节）。\n    pub file_length: u64,\n    /// 文件总块数。\n    pub total_chunks: u64,\n    /// 区间起始块序号（含）。\n    pub start_chunk: u64,\n    /// 区间结束块序号（不含）。\n    #[serde(with = \"hash_hex\")]\n    pub end_chunk: u64,\n    /// 承诺根。\n    pub root: Hash32,\n    /// 区间内块的原始数据（十六进制字符串），长度必须等于 `end_chunk - start_chunk`。\n    #[serde(with = \"vec_hex\")]\n    pub chunks: Vec<Vec<u8>>,\n    /// 自叶层向上的归约步骤；空向量表示该树只有一层（单块文件且区间即整树）。\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub steps: Vec<ProofStep>,\n}\n\n/// 证明校验失败的原因。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum VerifyError {\n    /// 块大小为 0。\n    BadChunkSize,\n    /// 区间非法（start > end，或越界，或空区间）。\n    BadRange,\n    /// `total_chunks` 与 `file_length/chunk_size` 不一致（典型的伪造长度攻击）。\n    LengthMismatch,\n    /// 携带的块数与区间长度不符。\n    ChunkCountMismatch,\n    /// 某步需要的兄弟哈希在证明中缺失。\n    MissingSibling,\n    /// 证明步骤数量与树高不符。\n    TooManySteps,\n    /// 重算根与承诺根不一致（数据/位置/根任一被篡改）。\n    RootMismatch,\n    /// 编码/结构错误。\n    Malformed(&'static str),\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for VerifyError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            VerifyError::BadChunkSize => write!(f, \"chunk_size must be > 0\"),\n            VerifyError::BadRange => write!(f, \"invalid chunk range\"),\n            VerifyError::LengthMismatch => {\n                write!(f, \"total_chunks inconsistent with file_length/chunk_size\")\n            }\n            VerifyError::ChunkCountMismatch => write!(f, \"chunks length does not match range\"),\n            VerifyError::MissingSibling => write!(f, \"proof step missing required sibling\"),\n            VerifyError::TooManySteps => write!(f, \"proof has more steps than tree height\"),\n            VerifyError::RootMismatch => write!(f, \"recomputed root does not match committed root\"),\n            VerifyError::Malformed(m) => write!(f, \"malformed proof: {m}\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::error::Error for VerifyError {}\n\nfn levels_height(mut n: u64) -> usize {\n    if n == 0 {\n        return 0;\n    }\n    let mut h = 0usize;\n    while n > 1 {\n        n = n.div_ceil(2);\n        h += 1;\n    }\n    h\n}\n\n/// 生成范围证明。\n///\n/// `read_chunk(idx)` 只需返回区间内的块数据；`levels` 为仓库当前各层（用于取兄弟哈希）。\npub fn prove_range<F>(\n    levels: &[Vec<Hash32>],\n    chunk_size: u64,\n    file_length: u64,\n    total_chunks: u64,\n    start: u64,\n    end: u64,\n    mut read_chunk: F,\n    root: Hash32,\n) -> Result<RangeProof, VerifyError>\nwhere\n    F: FnMut(u64) -> Option<Vec<u8>>,\n{\n    if chunk_size == 0 {\n        return Err(VerifyError::BadChunkSize);\n    }\n    if start >= end || start > total_chunks || end > total_chunks {\n        return Err(VerifyError::BadRange);\n    }\n    if levels.is_empty() || levels[0].len() as u64 != total_chunks {\n        return Err(VerifyError::Malformed(\"tree levels do not match total_chunks\"));\n    }\n    let mut chunks = Vec::with_capacity((end - start) as usize);\n    for i in start..end {\n        chunks.push(read_chunk(i).ok_or(VerifyError::Malformed(\"chunk read failed\"))?);\n    }\n\n    let mut steps: Vec<ProofStep> = Vec::new();\n    let (mut lo, mut hi) = (start, end); // 当前层覆盖区间 [lo, hi)\n    for level_no in 1u64..(levels.len() as u64) {\n        let level = &levels[(level_no - 1) as usize];\n        let width = level.len() as u64;\n\n        // 左邻居：lo 是某双亲的右孩子\n        let left = if lo % 2 == 1 {\n            Some(level[(lo - 1) as usize])\n        } else {\n            None\n        };\n        // 右邻居：hi 是某双亲的左孩子，且该双亲确有右孩子（hi 不是提升位）\n        let right = if hi % 2 == 1 && hi < width {\n            Some(level[hi as usize])\n        } else {\n            None\n        };\n        steps.push(ProofStep { left, right });\n\n        // 推进到上一层\n        lo = if left.is_some() { lo - 1 } else { lo } / 2;\n        hi = if right.is_some() { hi + 1 } else { hi } / 2;\n\n        if hi - lo == 1 {\n            break; // 已压缩到单个节点（可能尚未到根；提升位情形后续无需任何哈希）\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(RangeProof {\n        chunk_size,\n        file_length,\n        total_chunks,\n        start_chunk: start,\n        end_chunk: end,\n        root,\n        chunks,\n        steps,\n    })\n}\n\nimpl RangeProof {\n    /// 独立验证范围证明。不需要除证明以外的任何数据，因此验证者无需读取完整文件。\n    ///\n    /// 校验：长度一致性（防伪造长度）、区间合法性、块数一致性、逐块叶重算、逐层归约到根。\n    pub fn verify(&self) -> Result<(), VerifyError> {\n        if self.chunk_size == 0 {\n            return Err(VerifyError::BadChunkSize);\n        }\n        if self.start_chunk >= self.end_chunk\n            || self.start_chunk > self.total_chunks\n            || self.end_chunk > self.total_chunks\n        {\n            return Err(VerifyError::BadRange);\n        }\n        if chunk_count(self.file_length, self.chunk_size) != self.total_chunks {\n            return Err(VerifyError::LengthMismatch);\n        }\n        if self.chunks.len() as u64 != self.end_chunk - self.start_chunk {\n            return Err(VerifyError::ChunkCountMismatch);\n        }\n\n        // 空文件不可能有非空区间（上面 BadRange 已挡住 total_chunks==0 的情况）\n        let height = levels_height(self.total_chunks);\n        if self.steps.len() > height {\n            return Err(VerifyError::TooManySteps);\n        }\n\n        // 逐块重算叶哈希（带位置绑定）\n        let mut cur: Vec<Hash32> = Vec::with_capacity(self.chunks.len());\n        for (k, bytes) in self.chunks.iter().enumerate() {\n            let idx = self.start_chunk + k as u64;\n            cur.push(hash_leaf(idx, self.chunk_size, bytes));\n        }\n\n        let mut width = self.total_chunks; // 当前层整树宽度\n        let (mut lo, mut hi) = (self.start_chunk, self.end_chunk);\n\n        for level_no in 1u64..=(self.steps.len() as u64) {\n            let step = &self.steps[(level_no - 1) as usize];\n\n            // 把左/右兄弟拼到当前层切片两侧\n            let mut layer: Vec<Hash32> = Vec::with_capacity(cur.len() + 2);\n            let (slice_lo, slice_hi);\n            if let Some(lh) = step.left {\n                if lo % 2 != 1 {\n                    return Err(VerifyError::Malformed(\"unexpected left sibling\"));\n                }\n                layer.push(lh);\n                slice_lo = lo - 1;\n            } else {\n                slice_lo = lo;\n            }\n            layer.extend_from_slice(&cur);\n            if let Some(rh) = step.right {\n                if hi % 2 != 0 && hi < width {\n                    layer.push(rh);\n                    slice_hi = hi + 1;\n                } else {\n                    return Err(VerifyError::Malformed(\"unexpected right sibling\"));\n                }\n            } else {\n                slice_hi = hi;\n            }\n\n            let new_width = width.div_ceil(2);\n            let new_lo = slice_lo / 2;\n            let new_hi = slice_hi.div_ceil(2);\n\n            // 期望的输出长度；全层覆盖时直接归约整层到根\n            let expected = (new_hi - new_lo) as usize;\n            let mut next: Vec<Hash32> = Vec::with_capacity(expected);\n            let mut i = 0usize;\n            while i + 1 < layer.len() {\n                next.push(hash_pair(level_no, &layer[i], &layer[i + 1]));\n                i += 2;\n            }\n            if i < layer.len() {\n                if new_hi - new_lo == new_width {\n                    // 全层覆盖：末位奇数提升\n                    next.push(layer[i]);\n                } else {\n                    // 部分区间的切片末位恰好落在提升位：该节点不属于切片\n                }\n            }\n            if next.len() != expected {\n                return Err(VerifyError::MissingSibling);\n            }\n\n            cur = next;\n            lo = new_lo;\n            hi = new_hi;\n            width = new_width;\n\n            if hi - lo == 1 {\n                // 已收敛为单节点；不允许再有步骤\n                if self.steps.len() as u64 != level_no {\n                    return Err(VerifyError::TooManySteps);\n                }\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if cur.len() != 1 || lo != 0 || hi != 1 {\n            return Err(VerifyError::MissingSibling);\n        }\n        if cur[0] != self.root {\n            return Err(VerifyError::RootMismatch);\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n// ---- serde 适配器：Hash32 / Option<Hash32> / Vec<Vec<u8>> 以 hex 表示 ----\n\npub mod hash_hex {\n    use super::*;\n    use serde::de::Error as _;\n    use serde::{Deserializer, Serializer};\n\n    pub fn serialize<S: Serializer>(h: &Hash32, s: S) -> Result<S::Ok, S::Error> {\n        s.serialize_str(&hex_codec::to_hex(h))\n    }\n    pub fn deserialize<'de, D: Deserializer<'de>>(d: D) -> Result<Hash32, D::Error> {\n        let v = String::deserialize(d)?;\n        let b = hex_codec::from_hex(&v).ok_or_else(|| D::Error::custom(\"bad hex\"))?;\n        b.try_into().map_err(|_| D::Error::custom(\"hash must be 32 bytes\"))\n    }\n}\n\nmod opt_hash_hex {\n    use super::*;\n    use serde::de::Error as _;\n    use serde::{Deserializer, Serializer};\n\n    pub fn serialize<S: Serializer>(o: &Option<Hash32>, s: S) -> Result<S::Ok, S::Error> {\n        match o {\n            Some(h) => s.serialize_str(&hex_codec::to_hex(h)),\n            None => s.serialize_none(),\n        }\n    }\n    pub fn deserialize<'de, D: Deserializer<'de>>(d: D) -> Result<Option<Hash32>, D::Error> {\n        let v: Option<String> = Option::deserialize(d)?;\n        match v {\n            None => Ok(None),\n            Some(s) => {\n                let b = hex_codec::from_hex(&s).ok_or_else(|| D::Error::custom(\"bad hex\"))?;\n                let arr: Hash32 = b\n                    .try_into()\n                    .map_err(|_| D::Error::custom(\"hash must be 32 bytes\"))?;\n                Ok(Some(arr))\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\npub mod vec_hex {\n    use super::*;\n    use serde::de::Error as _;\n    use serde::ser::SerializeSeq;\n    use serde::{Deserializer, Serializer};\n\n    pub fn serialize<S: Serializer>(v: &Vec<Vec<u8>>, s: S) -> Result<S::Ok, S::Error> {\n        let mut seq = s.serialize_seq(Some(v.len()))?;\n        for c in v {\n            seq.serialize_element(&hex_codec::to_hex(c))?;\n        }\n        seq.end()\n    }\n    pub fn deserialize<'de, D: Deserializer<'de>>(d: D) -> Result<Vec<Vec<u8>>, D::Error> {\n        let raw: Vec<String> = Vec::deserialize(d)?;\n        raw.into_iter()\n            .map(|s| hex_codec::from_hex(&s).ok_or_else(|| D::Error::custom(\"bad hex\")))\n            .collect()\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    fn data_chunks(n: u64, size: usize) -> Vec<Vec<u8>> {\n        (0..n)\n            .map(|i| {\n                let mut v = vec![0u8; size];\n                v[0] = i as u8;\n                v.push((i % 251) as u8);\n                v\n            })\n            .collect()\n    }\n\n    fn leaves_of(chunks: &[Vec<u8>], cs: u64) -> Vec<Hash32> {\n        chunks\n            .iter()\n            .enumerate()\n            .map(|(i, c)| hash_leaf(i as u64, cs, c))\n            .collect()\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn count_and_split() {\n        let cs = DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE;\n        assert_eq!(chunk_count(0, cs), 0);\n        assert_eq!(chunk_count(1, cs), 1);\n        assert_eq!(chunk_count(cs, cs), 1);\n        assert_eq!(chunk_count(cs + 1, cs), 2);\n        assert_eq!(split_chunks(&[], cs).len(), 0);\n        let parts = split_chunks(&vec![7u8; (cs + 3) as usize], cs);\n        assert_eq!(parts.len(), 2);\n        assert_eq!(parts[0].len(), cs as usize);\n        assert_eq!(parts[1].len(), 3);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn empty_root_is_stable() {\n        let a = root_from_leaves(&[], 1024);\n        let b = root_from_leaves(&[], 1024);\n        assert_eq!(a, b);\n        assert_ne!(a, root_from_leaves(&[], 2048)); // chunk_size 绑定\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn domain_separation_leaf_vs_node() {\n        // 叶与内部不可能因为输入巧合而碰撞：不同前缀\n        let l = hash_leaf(0, 16, &[1]);\n        let n = hash_pair(1, &[9u8; 32], &[9u8; 32]);\n        assert_ne!(l, n);\n        // 同对节点不同 level 摘要不同\n        let (x, y) = ([1u8; 32], [2u8; 32]);\n        assert_ne!(hash_pair(1, &x, &y), hash_pair(2, &x, &y));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn single_chunk_tree() {\n        let chunks = data_chunks(1, 10);\n        let leaves = leaves_of(&chunks, 16);\n        let levels = build_levels(&leaves);\n        assert_eq!(levels.len(), 1);\n        assert_eq!(root_from_leaves(&leaves, 16), leaves[0]);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn odd_promotion_shapes() {\n        // 5 个叶：层宽 5 -> 3 -> 1，末位逐层提升\n        let chunks = data_chunks(5, 10);\n        let leaves = leaves_of(&chunks, 16);\n        let levels = build_levels(&leaves);\n        assert_eq!(levels.len(), 3);\n        assert_eq!(levels[1].len(), 3);\n        assert_eq!(levels[2].len(), 1);\n        // 提升链：levels[0][4] == levels[1][2]\n        assert_eq!(levels[0][4], levels[1][2]);\n        // levels[1][2] 提升到 levels[2][0]... 不对：第二层 3 个节点，末位再提升\n        let l1 = reduce_level(1, &levels[0]);\n        assert_eq!(l1[2], leaves[4]);\n        let l2 = reduce_level(2, &l1);\n        assert_eq!(l2[0], hash_pair(2, &l1[0], &l1[1]));\n        assert_eq!(l2[1], l1[2]);\n        assert_eq!(l2.len(), 2);\n        // 注意 5 叶实际层宽序列 5 -> 3 -> 2 -> 1\n        assert_eq!(build_levels(&leaves).len(), 4);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn incremental_matches_full_rebuild() {\n        let cs = 16u64;\n        for n in 1u64..=33 {\n            let chunks = data_chunks(n, 10);\n            let leaves = leaves_of(&chunks, cs);\n            let base = build_levels(&leaves);\n\n            // 更新块 0 与块 n-1（若不同）\n            let mut updated = chunks.clone();\n            let new0 = {\n                let mut v = updated[0].clone();\n                v[1] ^= 0xff;\n                v\n            };\n            updated[0] = new0;\n            let mut changes = vec![(0u64, hash_leaf(0, cs, &updated[0]))];\n            if n > 1 {\n                let mut last = updated[(n - 1) as usize].clone();\n                last[2] ^= 0x0f;\n                updated[(n - 1) as usize] = last;\n                changes.push((\n                    n - 1,\n                    hash_leaf(n - 1, cs, &updated[(n - 1) as usize]),\n                ));\n            }\n\n            let inc = update_levels(&base, &changes);\n            let full = build_levels(&leaves_of(&updated, cs));\n            assert_eq!(inc.len(), full.len(), \"n={n} height differs\");\n            for (li, (a, b)) in inc.iter().zip(full.iter()).enumerate() {\n                assert_eq!(a, b, \"n={n} level {li} differs (incremental vs rebuild)\");\n            }\n            assert_eq!(\n                inc.last().unwrap()[0],\n                rebuild_root_from_chunks(&updated, cs),\n                \"n={n} root mismatch\"\n            );\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn all_range_proofs_verify_head_and_tail() {\n        let cs = 16u64;\n        for n in 1u64..=17 {\n            let chunks = data_chunks(n, 12);\n            let leaves = leaves_of(&chunks, cs);\n            let levels = build_levels(&leaves);\n            let root = root_from_leaves(&leaves, cs);\n            let len = n * cs; // 每块填满，长度 = n*cs\n            let cases = [\n                (0u64, 1u64),       // 首块\n                (n - 1, n),         // 尾块\n                (0, n.min(3)),      // 首部范围\n                (n.saturating_sub(3).max(0) .. n,), // 尾部范围（用闭包代替）\n            ];\n            let _ = cases;\n            let tail_lo = n.saturating_sub(3).min(n - 1);\n            let ranges = [(0, 1), (n - 1, n), (0, n.min(3)), (tail_lo, n), (0, n)];\n            for (s, e) in ranges {\n                if s >= e {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                let p = prove_range(\n                    &levels,\n                    cs,\n                    len,\n                    n,\n                    s,\n                    e,\n                    |i| Some(chunks[i as usize].clone()),\n                    root,\n                )\n                .unwrap();\n                p.verify().unwrap_or_else(|err| {\n                    panic!(\"n={n} range [{s},{e}) verify failed: {err}\")\n                });\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn empty_file_proof_rules() {\n        let cs = 8u64;\n        let root = root_from_leaves(&[], cs);\n        // total_chunks=0 时任何区间都非法\n        let p = RangeProof {\n            chunk_size: cs,\n            file_length: 0,\n            total_chunks: 0,\n            start_chunk: 0,\n            end_chunk: 1,\n            root,\n            chunks: vec![vec![]],\n            steps: vec![],\n        };\n        assert_eq!(p.verify(), Err(VerifyError::BadRange));\n        // 长度一致但区间为空\n        let p2 = RangeProof {\n            start_chunk: 1,\n            end_chunk: 1,\n            ..p.clone()\n        };\n        assert_eq!(p2.verify(), Err(VerifyError::BadRange));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn forged_length_rejected() {\n        let cs = 16u64;\n        let chunks = data_chunks(4, 12);\n        let leaves = leaves_of(&chunks, cs);\n        let levels = build_levels(&leaves);\n        let root = root_from_leaves(&leaves, cs);\n        let mut p = prove_range(\n            &levels,\n            cs,\n            64,\n            4,\n            0,\n            1,\n            |i| Some(chunks[i as usize].clone()),\n            root,\n        )\n        .unwrap();\n        assert!(p.verify().is_ok());\n\n        // 攻击 1：把文件长度改大（声称多出不存在的块）\n        p.file_length = 100;\n        assert_eq!(p.verify(), Err(VerifyError::LengthMismatch));\n        p.file_length = 64;\n\n        // 攻击 2：篡改 total_chunks（与长度/块大小不符）\n        p.total_chunks = 5;\n        assert_eq!(p.verify(), Err(VerifyError::LengthMismatch));\n        p.total_chunks = 4;\n\n        // 攻击 3：声明的 total_chunks 与长度自洽，但与树不符 -> 归约路径/根失败\n        // (4 块, len=64) -> (8 块, len=128) 自洽，但只有 1 块数据，steps 走不到根\n        p.total_chunks = 8;\n        p.file_length = 128;\n        assert!(p.verify().is_err());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn misplaced_and_tampered_proofs_rejected() {\n        let cs = 16u64;\n        let chunks = data_chunks(8, 12);\n        let leaves = leaves_of(&chunks, cs);\n        let levels = build_levels(&leaves);\n        let root = root_from_leaves(&leaves, cs);\n\n        // 错位：证明声称块 3，实际携带块 0 的数据（叶哈希带位置，必失败）\n        let mut p = prove_range(\n            &levels,\n            cs,\n            128,\n            8,\n            3,\n            4,\n            |_| Some(chunks[0].clone()), // 故意给错块\n            root,\n        )\n        .unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(p.verify(), Err(VerifyError::RootMismatch));\n\n        // 正确证明，篡改一个字节\n        let mut p =    Some(s) => {\n                let b = hex_codec::from_hex(&s).ok_or_else(|| D::Error::custom(\"bad hex\"))?;\n                let arr: Hash32 = b\n                    .try_into()\n                    .map_err(|_| D::Error::custom(\"hash must be 32 bytes\"))?;\n                Ok(Some(arr))\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\npub mod vec_hex {\n    use super::*;\n    use serde::de::Error as _;\n    use serde::ser::SerializeSeq;\n    use serde::{Deserializer, Serializer};\n\n    pub fn serialize<S: Serializer>(v: &Vec<Vec<u8>>, s: S) -> Result<S::Ok, S::Error> {\n        let mut seq = s.serialize_seq(Some(v.len()))?;\n        for c in v {\n            seq.serialize_element(&hex_codec::to_hex(c))?;\n        }\n        seq.end()\n    }\n    pub fn deserialize<'de, D: Deserializer<'de>>(d: D) -> Result<Vec<Vec<u8>>, D::Error> {\n        let raw: Vec<String> = Vec::deserialize(d)?;\n        raw.into_iter()\n            .map(|s| hex_codec::from_hex(&s).ok_or_else(|| D::Error::custom(\"bad hex\")))\n            .collect()\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    fn data_chunks(n: u64, size: usize) -> Vec<Vec<u8>> {\n        (0..n)\n 3，实际携带块 0 的数据（叶哈希带位置，必失败）\n        let mut p = prove_range(\n            &levels,\n            cs,\n            128,\n            8,\n            3,\n            4,\n            |_| Merkle 树：分块、域分离哈希、奇数提升、范围证明与验证。\n//!\n//! # 哈希规范（所有参与方必须一致）\n//!\n//! - 底层哈希：SHA-256，输出 32 字节。\n//! - **空文件**（0 个块）的根固定为 `SHA-256(\"MERKLE_EMPTY_ROOT_v1\" || u64-le(chunk_size))`。\n//! - **叶节点**（对应一个数据块）：`SHA-256(0x00 || u64-le(chunk_index) || u64-le(chunk_size) || chunk_bytes)`。\n//!   块序号绑定进叶摘要，防止块在证明中被重排。\n//! - **内部节点**：\n//!   - 普通双亲：`SHA-256(0x01 || u64-le(level) || left_hash || right_hash)`，level 从 1 开始（level0 为叶层）。\n//!   - **奇数提升**：某层节点数为奇数时，最后一个节点不复制、不哈希，原样提升到上一层同位置。\n//! - 块大小是协议参数（默认 4096），参与叶/空根哈希，防止跨参数混用。\n//!\n//! 域前缀（0x00 / 0x01）使叶与内部节点不可能互相伪造；level 绑定使同值在不同层产生不同摘要。\n\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\nuse sha2::{Digest, Sha256};\n\n/// 默认块大小（字节）。\npub const DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE: u64 = 4096;\n\n/// SHA-256 摘要。\npub type Hash32 = [u8; 32];\n\n/// 计算文件需要的块数。空文件为 0，否则 `ceil(len / chunk_size)`。\npub fn chunk_count(file_len: u64, chunk_size: u64) -> u64 {\n    assert!(chunk_size > 0, \"chunk_size must be > 0\");\n    file_len.div_ceil(chunk_size)\n}\n\n/// 块 `index` 在文件中的字节偏移。\npub fn chunk_offset(index: u64, chunk_size: u64) -> u64 {\n    index.checked_mul(chunk_size).expect(\"offset overflow\")\n}\n\nfn hash_empty_root(chunk_size: u64) -> Hash32 {\n    let mut h = Sha256::new();\n    h.update(b\"MERKLE_EMPTY_ROOT_v1\");\n    h.update(chunk_size.to_le_bytes());\n    h.finalize().into()\n}\n\n/// 计算叶节点摘要：`SHA-256(0x00 || u64-le(index) || u64-le(chunk_size) || bytes)`。\npub fn hash_leaf(index: u64, chunk_size: u64, bytes: &[u8]) -> Hash32 {\n    let mut h = Sha256::new();\n    h.update([0x00u8]);\n    h.update(index.to_le_bytes());\n    h.update(chunk_size.to_le_bytes());\n    h.update(bytes);\n    h.finalize().into()\n}\n\n/// 计算内部双亲摘要：`SHA-256(0x01 || u64-le(level) || left || right)`。\npub fn hash_pair(level: u64, left: &Hash32, right: &Hash32) -> Hash32 {\n    let mut h = Sha256::new();\n    h.update([0x01u8]);\n    h.update(level.to_le_bytes());\n    h.update(left);\n    h.update(right);\n    h.finalize().into()\n}\n\n/// 一层节点的奇偶归约：两两哈希，奇数个时末尾节点原样提升。\n///\n/// 返回新一层（长度 `ceil(n/2)`）。\npub fn reduce_level(level_no: u64, nodes: &[Hash32]) -> Vec<Hash32> {\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(nodes.len().div_ceil(2));\n    let mut i = 0;\n    while i + 1 < nodes.len() {\n        out.push(hash_pair(level_no, &nodes[i], &nodes[i + 1]));\n        i += 2;\n    }\n    if i < nodes.len() {\n        // 奇数提升：最后一个节点不哈希直接上移\n        out.push(nodes[i]);\n    }\n    out\n}\n\n/// 由叶层自底向上构建完整树，返回各层；`levels[0]` 为叶层。\npub fn build_levels(leaves: &[Hash32]) -> Vec<Vec<Hash32>> {\n    let mut levels = Vec::new();\n    levels.push(leaves.to_vec());\n    let mut level_no = 1u64;\n    while levels.last().unwrap().len() > 1 {\n        let next = reduce_level(level_no, levels.last().unwrap());\n        levels.push(next);\n        level_no += 1;\n    }\n    levels\n}\n\n/// 由所有叶哈希求根。空树（无块）使用 [`hash_empty_root`]。\npub fn root_from_leaves(leaves: &[Hash32], chunk_size: u64) -> Hash32 {\n    if leaves.is_empty() {\n        return hash_empty_root(chunk_size);\n    }\n    let levels = build_levels(leaves);\n    levels.last().unwrap()[0]\n}\n\n/// 由全部块数据全量重建根（验收基线：与增量更新后的根比较）。\npub fn rebuild_root_from_chunks(chunks: &[Vec<u8>], chunk_size: u64) -> Hash32 {\n    let leaves: Vec<Hash32> = chunks\n        .iter()\n        .enumerate()\n        .map(|(i, c)| hash_leaf(i as u64, chunk_size, c))\n        .collect();\n    root_from_leaves(&leaves, chunk_size)\n}\n\n/// 按块大小切分一段文件字节。\npub fn split_chunks(data: &[u8], chunk_size: u64) -> Vec<Vec<u8>> {\n    let cs = chunk_size as usize;\n    if data.is_empty() {\n        return Vec::new();\n    }\n    let n = data.len().div_ceil(cs);\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(n);\n    for i in 0..n {\n        let end = (i * cs + cs).min(data.len());\n        out.push(data[i * cs..end].to_vec());\n    }\n    out\n}\n\n/// 把叶层上的若干修改（块序号 -> 新叶哈希）增量合并进既有各层。\n///\n/// 仅重算受影响路径：每层只对“脏”双亲调用 [`hash_pair`]；奇数提升位与未涉及的子树保持不动。\n/// 返回新的各层。\npub fn update_levels(prev: &[Vec<Hash32>], changes: &[(u64, Hash32)]) -> Vec<Vec<Hash32>> {\n    let mut levels: Vec<Vec<Hash32>> = prev.to_vec();\n    if levels.is_empty() {\n        return levels;\n    }\n    let mut dirty: Vec<(u64, Hash32)> = changes.to_vec();\n    for level_no in 1u64..(levels.len() as u64) {\n        let width = levels[(level_no - 1) as usize].len();\n        for &(idx, h) in &dirty {\n            levels[(level_no - 1) as usize][idx as usize] = h;\n        }\n        let mut next_dirty = Vec::with_capacity(dirty.len());\n        for (idx, _) in dirty.drain(..) {\n            let parent = idx / 2;\n            if idx % 2 == 1 {\n                // 脏节点是右孩子，且它是该层最后一个（奇数提升），直接把新值提升\n                if idx as usize == width - 1 {\n                    next_dirty.push((parent, levels[(level_no - 1) as usize][idx as usize]));\n                    continue;\n                }\n                let l = levels[(level_no - 1) as usize][(idx - 1) as usize];\n                let r = levels[(level_no - 1) as usize][idx as usize];\n                next_dirty.push((parent, hash_pair(level_no, &l, &r)));\n            } else {\n                let l = levels[(level_no - 1) as usize][idx as usize];\n                if idx as usize + 1 < width {\n                    let r = levels[(level_no - 1) as usize][(idx + 1) as usize];\n                    next_dirty.push((parent, hash_pair(level_no, &l, &r)));\n                } else {\n                    // 左孩子但已是层末（奇数提升）\n                    next_dirty.push((parent, l));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        // 同一双亲可能因两个孩子都脏而被压入两次，去重保最后值\n        next_dirty.sort_by_key(|(i, _)| *i);\n        next_dirty.dedup_by(|a, b| {\n            if a.0 == b.0 {\n                // 保留后写入的（即基于更完整脏状态计算的）值\n                b.1 = a.1;\n                true\n            } else {\n                false\n            }\n        });\n        for &(idx, h) in &next_dirty {\n            levels[level_no as usize][idx as usize] = h;\n        }\n        dirty = next_dirty;\n    }\n    levels\n}\n\n/// 范围证明中的一层“邻居”。每一层至多两个哈希：\n///\n/// - `left`：当前区间左侧相邻兄弟（当区间左边界是父节点右孩子时存在）\n/// - `right`：当前区间右侧相邻兄弟（当区间右边界是父节点左孩子且未落在提升位时存在）\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct ProofStep {\n    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\", with = \"opt_hash_hex\")]\n    pub left: Option<Hash32>,\n    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\", with = \"opt_hash_hex\")]\n    pub right: Option<Hash32>,\n}\n\n/// 一个连续块区间 `[start, end)` 的 Merkle 包含证明。\n///\n/// 证明自带块数据（仅区间内块，**不读取完整文件**），验证者逐块重算叶哈希后自底向上校验到根。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct RangeProof {\n    /// 协议块大小（字节）。\n    pub chunk_size: u64,\n    /// 文件总长度（字节）。\n    pub file_length: u64,\n    /// 文件总块数。\n    pub total_chunks: u64,\n    /// 区间起始块序号（含）。\n    pub start_chunk: u64,\n    /// 区间结束块序号（不含）。\n    #[serde(with = \"hash_hex\")]\n    pub end_chunk: u64,\n    /// 承诺根。\n    pub root: Hash32,\n    /// 区间内块的原始数据（十六进制字符串），长度必须等于 `end_chunk - start_chunk`。\n    #[serde(with = \"vec_hex\")]\n    pub chunks: Vec<Vec<u8>>,\n    /// 自叶层向上的归约步骤；空向量表示该树只有一层（单块文件且区间即整树）。\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub steps: Vec<ProofStep>,\n}\n\n/// 证明校验失败的原因。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum VerifyError {\n    /// 块大小为 0。\n    BadChunkSize,\n    /// 区间非法（start > end，或越界，或空区间）。\n    BadRange,\n    /// `total_chunks` 与 `file_length/chunk_size` 不一致（典型的伪造长度攻击）。\n    LengthMismatch,\n    /// 携带的块数与区间长度不符。\n    ChunkCountMismatch,\n    /// 某步需要的兄弟哈希在证明中缺失。\n    MissingSibling,\n    /// 证明步骤数量与树高不符。\n    TooManySteps,\n    /// 重算根与承诺根不一致（数据/位置/根任一被篡改）。\n    RootMismatch,\n    /// 编码/结构错误。\n    Malformed(&'static str),\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for VerifyError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            VerifyError::BadChunkSize => write!(f, \"chunk_size must be > 0\"),\n            VerifyError::BadRange => write!(f, \"invalid chunk range\"),\n            VerifyError::LengthMismatch => {\n                write!(f, \"total_chunks inconsistent with file_length/chunk_size\")\n            }\n            VerifyError::ChunkCountMismatch => write!(f, \"chunks length does not match range\"),\n            VerifyError::MissingSibling => write!(f, \"proof step missing required sibling\"),\n            VerifyError::TooManySteps => write!(f, \"proof has more steps than tree height\"),\n            VerifyError::RootMismatch => write!(f, \"recomputed root does not match committed root\"),\n            VerifyError::Malformed(m) => write!(f, \"malformed proof: {m}\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::error::Error for VerifyError {}\n\nfn levels_height(mut n: u64) -> usize {\n    if n == 0 {\n        return 0;\n    }\n    let mut h = 0usize;\n    while n > 1 {\n        n = n.div_ceil(2);\n        h += 1;\n    }\n    h\n}\n\n/// 生成范围证明。\n///\n/// `read_chunk(idx)` 只需返回区间内的块数据；`levels` 为仓库当前各层（用于取兄弟哈希）。\npub fn prove_range<F>(\n    levels: &[Vec<Hash32>],\n    chunk_size: u64,\n    file_length: u64,\n    total_chunks: u64,\n    start: u64,\n    end: u64,\n    mut read_chunk: F,\n    root: Hash32,\n) -> Result<RangeProof, VerifyError>\nwhere\n    F: FnMut(u64) -> Option<Vec<u8>>,\n{\n    if chunk_size == 0 {\n        return Err(VerifyError::BadChunkSize);\n    }\n    if start >= end || start > total_chunks || end > total_chunks {\n        return Err(VerifyError::BadRange);\n    }\n    if levels.is_empty() || levels[0].len() as u64 != total_chunks {\n        return Err(VerifyError::Malformed(\"tree levels do not match total_chunks\"));\n    }\n    let mut chunks = Vec::with_capacity((end - start) as usize);\n    for i in start..end {\n        chunks.push(read_chunk(i).ok_or(VerifyError::Malformed(\"chunk read failed\"))?);\n    }\n\n    let mut steps: Vec<ProofStep> = Vec::new();\n    let (mut lo, mut hi) = (start, end); // 当前层覆盖区间 [lo, hi)\n    for level_no in 1u64..(levels.len() as u64) {\n        let level = &levels[(level_no - 1) as usize];\n        let width = level.len() as u64;\n\n        // 左邻居：lo 是某双亲的右孩子\n        let left = if lo % 2 == 1 {\n            Some(level[(lo - 1) as usize])\n        } else {\n            None\n        };\n        // 右邻居：hi 是某双亲的左孩子，且该双亲确有右孩子（hi 不是提升位）\n        let right = if hi % 2 == 1 && hi < width {\n            Some(level[hi as usize])\n        } else {\n            None\n        };\n        steps.push(ProofStep { left, right });\n\n        // 推进到上一层\n        lo = if left.is_some() { lo - 1 } else { lo } / 2;\n        hi = if right.is_some() { hi + 1 } else { hi } / 2;\n\n        if hi - lo == 1 {\n            break; // 已压缩到单个节点（可能尚未到根；提升位情形后续无需任何哈希）\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(RangeProof {\n        chunk_size,\n        file_length,\n        total_chunks,\n        start_chunk: start,\n        end_chunk: end,\n        root,\n        chunks,\n        steps,\n    })\n}\n\nimpl RangeProof {\n    /// 独立验证范围证明。不需要除证明以外的任何数据，因此验证者无需读取完整文件。\n    ///\n    /// 校验：长度一致性（防伪造长度）、区间合法性、块数一致性、逐块叶重算、逐层归约到根。\n    pub fn verify(&self) -> Result<(), VerifyError> {\n        if self.chunk_size == 0 {\n            return Err(VerifyError::BadChunkSize);\n        }\n        if self.start_chunk >= self.end_chunk\n            || self.start_chunk > self.total_chunks\n            || self.end_chunk > self.total_chunks\n        {\n            return Err(VerifyError::BadRange);\n        }\n        if chunk_count(self.file_length, self.chunk_size) != self.total_chunks {\n            return Err(VerifyError::LengthMismatch);\n        }\n        if self.chunks.len() as u64 != self.end_chunk - self.start_chunk {\n            return Err(VerifyError::ChunkCountMismatch);\n        }\n\n        // 空文件不可能有非空区间（上面 BadRange 已挡住 total_chunks==0 的情况）\n        let height = levels_height(self.total_chunks);\n        if self.steps.len() > height {\n            return Err(VerifyError::TooManySteps);\n        }\n\n        // 逐块重算叶哈希（带位置绑定）\n        let mut cur: Vec<Hash32> = Vec::with_capacity(self.chunks.len());\n        for (k, bytes) in self.chunks.iter().enumerate() {\n            let idx = self.start_chunk + k as u64;\n            cur.push(hash_leaf(idx, self.chunk_size, bytes));\n        }\n\n        let mut width = self.total_chunks; // 当前层整树宽度\n        let (mut lo, mut hi) = (self.start_chunk, self.end_chunk);\n\n        for level_no in 1u64..=(self.steps.len() as u64) {\n            let step = &self.steps[(level_no - 1) as usize];\n\n            // 把左/右兄弟拼到当前层切片两侧\n            let mut layer: Vec<Hash32> = Vec::with_capacity(cur.len() + 2);\n            let (slice_lo, slice_hi);\n            if let Some(lh) = step.left {\n                if lo % 2 != 1 {\n                    return Err(VerifyError::Malformed(\"unexpected left sibling\"));\n                }\n                layer.push(lh);\n                slice_lo = lo - 1;\n            } else {\n                slice_lo = lo;\n            }\n            layer.extend_from_slice(&cur);\n            if let Some(rh) = step.right {\n                if hi % 2 != 0 && hi < width {\n                    layer.push(rh);\n                    slice_hi = hi + 1;\n                } else {\n                    return Err(VerifyError::Malformed(\"unexpected right sibling\"));\n                }\n            } else {\n                slice_hi = hi;\n            }\n\n            let new_width = width.div_ceil(2);\n            let new_lo = slice_lo / 2;\n            let new_hi = slice_hi.div_ceil(2);\n\n            // 期望的输出长度；全层覆盖时直接归约整层到根\n            let expected = (new_hi - new_lo) as usize;\n            let mut next: Vec<Hash32> = Vec::with_capacity(expected);\n            let mut i = 0usize;\n            while i + 1 < layer.len() {\n                next.push(hash_pair(level_no, &layer[i], &layer[i + 1]));\n                i += 2;\n            }\n            if i < layer.len() {\n                if new_hi - new_lo == new_width {\n                    // 全层覆盖：末位奇数提升\n                    next.push(layer[i]);\n                } else {\n                    // 部分区间的切片末位恰好落在提升位：该节点不属于切片\n                }\n            }\n            if next.len() != expected {\n                return Err(VerifyError::MissingSibling);\n            }\n\n            cur = next;\n            lo = new_lo;\n            hi = new_hi;\n            width = new_width;\n\n            if hi - lo == 1 {\n                // 已收敛为单节点；不允许再有步骤\n                if self.steps.len() as u64 != level_no {\n                    return Err(VerifyError::TooManySteps);\n                }\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if cur.len() != 1 || lo != 0 || hi != 1 {\n            return Err(VerifyError::MissingSibling);\n        }\n        if cur[0] != self.root {\n            return Err(VerifyError::RootMismatch);\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n// ---- serde 适配器：Hash32 / Option<Hash32> / Vec<Vec<u8>> 以 hex 表示 ----\n\npub mod hash_hex {\n    use super::*;\n    use serde::de::Error as _;\n    use serde::{Deserializer, Serializer};\n\n    pub fn serialize<S: Serializer>(h: &Hash32, s: S) -> Result<S::Ok, S::Error> {\n        s.serialize_str(&hex_codec::to_hex(h))\n    }\n    pub fn deserialize<'de, D: Deserializer<'de>>(d: D) -> Result<Hash32, D::Error> {\n        let v = String::deserialize(d)?;\n        let b = hex_codec::from_hex(&v).ok_or_else(|| D::Error::custom(\"bad hex\"))?;\n        b.try_into().map_err(|_| D::Error::custom(\"hash must be 32 bytes\"))\n    }\n}\n\nmod opt_hash_hex {\n    use super::*;\n    use serde::de::Error as _;\n    use serde::{Deserializer, Serializer};\n\n    pub fn serialize<S: Serializer>(o: &Option<Hash32>, s: S) -> Result<S::Ok, S::Error> {\n        match o {\n            Some(h) => s.serialize_str(&hex_codec::to_hex(h)),\n            None => s.serialize_none(),\n        }\n    }\n    pub fn deserialize<'de, D: Deserializer<'de>>(d: D) -> Result<Option<Hash32>, D::Error> {\n        let v: Option<String> = Option::deserialize(d)?;\n        match v {\n            None => Ok(None),\n            Some(s) => {\n                let b = hex_codec::from_hex(&s).ok_or_else(|| D::Error::custom(\"bad hex\"))?;\n                let arr: Hash32 = b\n                    .try_into()\n                    .map_err(|_| D::Error::custom(\"hash must be 32 bytes\"))?;\n                Ok(Some(arr))\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\npub mod vec_hex {\n    use super::*;\n    use serde::de::Error as _;\n    use serde::ser::SerializeSeq;\n    use serde::{Deserializer, Serializer};\n\n    pub fn serialize<S: Serializer>(v: &Vec<Vec<u8>>, s: S) -> Result<S::Ok, S::Error> {\n        let mut seq = s.serialize_seq(Some(v.len()))?;\n        for c in v {\n            seq.serialize_element(&hex_codec::to_hex(c))?;\n        }\n        seq.end()\n    }\n    pub fn deserialize<'de, D: Deserializer<'de>>(d: D) -> Result<Vec<Vec<u8>>, D::Error> {\n        let raw: Vec<String> = Vec::deserialize(d)?;\n        raw.into_iter()\n            .map(|s| hex_codec::from_hex(&s).ok_or_else(|| D::Error::custom(\"bad hex\")))\n            .collect()\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    fn data_chunks(n: u64, size: usize) -> Vec<Vec<u8>> {\n        (0..n)\n            .map(|i| {\n                let mut v = vec![0u8; size];\n                v[0] = i as u8;\n                v.push((i % 251) as u8);\n                v\n            })\n            .collect()\n    }\n\n    fn leaves_of(chunks: &[Vec<u8>], cs: u64) -> Vec<Hash32> {\n        chunks\n            .iter()\n            .enumerate()\n            .map(|(i, c)| hash_leaf(i as u64, cs, c))\n            .collect()\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn count_and_split() {\n        let cs = DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE;\n        assert_eq!(chunk_count(0, cs), 0);\n        assert_eq!(chunk_count(1, cs), 1);\n        assert_eq!(chunk_count(cs, cs), 1);\n        assert_eq!(chunk_count(cs + 1, cs), 2);\n        assert_eq!(split_chunks(&[], cs).len(), 0);\n        let parts = split_chunks(&vec![7u8; (cs + 3) as usize], cs);\n        assert_eq!(parts.len(), 2);\n        assert_eq!(parts[0].len(), cs as usize);\n        assert_eq!(parts[1].len(), 3);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn empty_root_is_stable() {\n        let a = root_from_leaves(&[], 1024);\n        let b = root_from_leaves(&[], 1024);\n        assert_eq!(a, b);\n        assert_ne!(a, root_from_leaves(&[], 2048)); // chunk_size 绑定\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn domain_separation_leaf_vs_node() {\n        // 叶与内部不可能因为输入巧合而碰撞：不同前缀\n        let l = hash_leaf(0, 16, &[1]);\n        let n = hash_pair(1, &[9u8; 32], &[9u8; 32]);\n        assert_ne!(l, n);\n        // 同对节点不同 level 摘要不同\n        let (x, y) = ([1u8; 32], [2u8; 32]);\n        assert_ne!(hash_pair(1, &x, &y), hash_pair(2, &x, &y));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn single_chunk_tree() {\n        let chunks = data_chunks(1, 10);\n        let leaves = leaves_of(&chunks, 16);\n        let levels = build_levels(&leaves);\n        assert_eq!(levels.len(), 1);\n        assert_eq!(root_from_leaves(&leaves, 16), leaves[0]);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn odd_promotion_shapes() {\n        // 5 个叶：层宽 5 -> 3 -> 1，末位逐层提升\n        let chunks = data_chunks(5, 10);\n        let leaves = leaves_of(&chunks, 16);\n        let levels = build_levels(&leaves);\n        assert_eq!(levels.len(), 3);\n        assert_eq!(levels[1].len(), 3);\n        assert_eq!(levels[2].len(), 1);\n        // 提升链：levels[0][4] == levels[1][2]\n        assert_eq!(levels[0][4], levels[1][2]);\n        // levels[1][2] 提升到 levels[2][0]... 不对：第二层 3 个节点，末位再提升\n        let l1 = reduce_level(1, &levels[0]);\n        assert_eq!(l1[2], leaves[4]);\n        let l2 = reduce_level(2, &l1);\n        assert_eq!(l2[0], hash_pair(2, &l1[0], &l1[1]));\n        assert_eq!(l2[1], l1[2]);\n        assert_eq!(l2.len(), 2);\n        // 注意 5 叶实际层宽序列 5 -> 3 -> 2 -> 1\n        assert_eq!(build_levels(&leaves).len(), 4);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn incremental_matches_full_rebuild() {\n        let cs = 16u64;\n        for n in 1u64..=33 {\n            let chunks = data_chunks(n, 10);\n            let leaves = leaves_of(&chunks, cs);\n            let base = build_levels(&leaves);\n\n            // 更新块 0 与块 n-1（若不同）\n            let mut updated = chunks.clone();\n            let new0 = {\n                let mut v = updated[0].clone();\n                v[1] ^= 0xff;\n                v\n            };\n            updated[0] = new0;\n            let mut changes = vec![(0u64, hash_leaf(0, cs, &updated[0]))];\n            if n > 1 {\n                let mut last = updated[(n - 1) as usize].clone();\n                last[2] ^= 0x0f;\n                updated[(n - 1) as usize] = last;\n                changes.push((\n                    n - 1,\n                    hash_leaf(n - 1, cs, &updated[(n - 1) as usize]),\n                ));\n            }\n\n            let inc = update_levels(&base, &changes);\n            let full = build_levels(&leaves_of(&updated, cs));\n            assert_eq!(inc.len(), full.len(), \"n={n} height differs\");\n            for (li, (a, b)) in inc.iter().zip(full.iter()).enumerate() {\n                assert_eq!(a, b, \"n={n} level {li} differs (incremental vs rebuild)\");\n            }\n            assert_eq!(\n                inc.last().unwrap()[0],\n                rebuild_root_from_chunks(&updated, cs),\n                \"n={n} root mismatch\"\n            );\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn all_range_proofs_verify_head_and_tail() {\n        let cs = 16u64;\n        for n in 1u64..=17 {\n            let chunks = data_chunks(n, 12);\n            let leaves = leaves_of(&chunks, cs);\n            let levels = build_levels(&leaves);\n            let root = root_from_leaves(&leaves, cs);\n            let len = n * cs; // 每块填满，长度 = n*cs\n            let cases = [\n                (0u64, 1u64),       // 首块\n                (n - 1, n),         // 尾块\n                (0, n.min(3)),      // 首部范围\n                (n.saturating_sub(3).max(0) .. n,), // 尾部范围（用闭包代替）\n            ];\n            let _ = cases;\n            let tail_lo = n.saturating_sub(3).min(n - 1);\n            let ranges = [(0, 1), (n - 1, n), (0, n.min(3)), (tail_lo, n), (0, n)];\n            for (s, e) in ranges {\n                if s >= e {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                let p = prove_range(\n                    &levels,\n                    cs,\n                    len,\n                    n,\n                    s,\n                    e,\n                    |i| Some(chunks[i as usize].clone()),\n                    root,\n                )\n                .unwrap();\n                p.verify().unwrap_or_else(|err| {\n                    panic!(\"n={n} range [{s},{e}) verify failed: {err}\")\n                });\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn empty_file_proof_rules() {\n        let cs = 8u64;\n        let root = root_from_leaves(&[], cs);\n        // total_chunks=0 时任何区间都非法\n        let p = RangeProof {\n            chunk_size: cs,\n            file_length: 0,\n            total_chunks: 0,\n            start_chunk: 0,\n            end_chunk: 1,\n            root,\n            chunks: vec![vec![]],\n            steps: vec![],\n        };\n        assert_eq!(p.verify(), Err(VerifyError::BadRange));\n        // 长度一致但区间为空\n        let p2 = RangeProof {\n            start_chunk: 1,\n            end_chunk: 1,\n            ..p.clone()\n        };\n        assert_eq!(p2.verify(), Err(VerifyError::BadRange));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn forged_length_rejected() {\n        let cs = 16u64;\n        let chunks = data_chunks(4, 12);\n        let leaves = leaves_of(&chunks, cs);\n        let levels = build_levels(&leaves);\n        let root = root_from_leaves(&leaves, cs);\n        let mut p = prove_range(\n            &levels,\n            cs,\n            64,\n            4,\n            0,\n            1,\n            |i| Some(chunks[i as usize].clone()),\n            root,\n        )\n        .unwrap();\n        assert!(p.verify().is_ok());\n\n        // 攻击 1：把文件长度改大（声称多出不存在的块）\n        p.file_length = 100;\n        assert_eq!(p.verify(), Err(VerifyError::LengthMismatch));\n        p.file_length = 64;\n\n        // 攻击 2：篡改 total_chunks（与长度/块大小不符）\n        p.total_chunks = 5;\n        assert_eq!(p.verify(), Err(VerifyError::LengthMismatch));\n        p.total_chunks = 4;\n\n        // 攻击 3：声明的 total_chunks 与长度自洽，但与树不符 -> 归约路径/根失败\n        // (4 块, len=64) -> (8 块, len=128) 自洽，但只有 1 块数据，steps 走不到根\n        p.total_chunks = 8;\n        p.file_length = 128;\n        assert!(p.verify().is_err());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn misplaced_and_tampered_proofs_rejected() {\n        let cs = 16u64;\n        let chunks = data_chunks(8, 12);\n        let leaves = leaves_of(&chunks, cs);\n        let levels = build_levels(&leaves);\n        let root = root_from_leaves(&leaves, cs);\n\n        // 错位：证明声称块 3，实际携带块 0 的数据（叶哈希带位置，必失败）\n        let mut p = prove_range(\n            &levels,\n            cs,\n            128,\n            8,\n            3,\n            4,\n            |_| Some(chunks[0].clone()), // 故意给错块\n            root,\n        )\n        .unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(p.verify(), Err(VerifyError::RootMismatch));\n\n        // 正确证明，篡改一个字节\n        let mut p = prove_range(\n            &levels,\n            cs,\n            128,\n            8,\n            2,\n            3,\n            |i| Some(chunks[i as usize].clone()),\n            root,\n        )\n        .unwrap();\n        assert!(p.verify().is_ok());\n        p.chunks[0][0] ^= 0x01;\n        assert_eq!(p.verify(), Err(VerifyError::RootMismatch));\n\n        // 错位证明：把 [2,3) 的证明字段改成 [3,4)（兄弟路径不再匹配）\n        let p2 = RangeProof {\n            start_chunk: 3,\n            end_chunk: 4,\n            ..p.clone()\n        };\n        // p 的数据是块2内容且已被改一位；还原后移动位置仍应失败\n        let mut p2 {"parentUuid":"dc1f608f-0b05-4426-8d54-7c56b87312a2","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_ukvt4dttiltveazqz1hq4o2e","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp10/b/src/vfs.rs","content":"//! 可注入的文件 I/O 层。\n//!\n//! 存储库逻辑只依赖 [`Vfs`] trait，因此测试中可以：\n//! - 用 [`RealVfs`] 跑真实磁盘（含 fsync 语义）；\n//! - 用 [`FaultyVfs`] 包装任意内部 VFS，在指定步骤注入 I/O 错误或“崩溃”（错误后\n//!   丢弃所有未落盘的写入），以验证 WAL 提交边界与崩溃恢复。\n\nuse std::collections::{BTreeMap, HashMap};\nuse std::io::{self, Read, Seek, SeekFrom, Write};\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\n/// 文件句柄抽象（读写、定位、同步）。\npub trait VfsFile: Read + Write + Seek {\n    fn sync_all(&mut self) -> io::Result<()>;\n    fn len(&mut self) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        let pos = self.stream_position()?;\n        let end = self.seek(SeekFrom::End(0))?;\n        self.seek(SeekFrom::Start(pos))?;\n        Ok(end)\n    }\n}\n\n/// 存储库需要的最小文件系统操作集。路径均为相对仓库根的相对路径。\npub trait Vfs: Send + Sync {\n    /// 创建缺失的目录（含父目录）。\n    fn mkdirs(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 路径是否存在（文件或目录）。\n    fn exists(&self, rel: &str) -> bool;\n    /// 以可读可写方式打开已存在文件（不创建）。\n    fn open(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Box<dyn VfsFile>>;\n    /// 创建新文件（截断），父目录需已存在。\n    fn create(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Box<dyn VfsFile>>;\n    /// 删除文件。\n    fn remove(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 原子改名（用于 manifest 提交）。\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 列出目录下文件名（不递归）。\n    fn list(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<String>>;\n}\n\n// ---------------- 真实文件系统 ----------------\n\n/// 基于 `std::fs` 的实现，仓库根目录 [`RealVfs::root`]。\npub struct RealVfs {\n    root: PathBuf,\n}\n\nimpl RealVfs {\n    pub fn new(root: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> Self {\n        Self { root: root.into() }\n    }\n\n    fn path(&self, rel: &str) -> PathBuf {\n        // 防止逃逸仓库根\n        let p = Path::new(rel);\n        assert!(\n            !p.is_absolute() && p.components().all(|c| c != std::path::Component::ParentDir),\n            \"vfs path escapes root: {rel}\"\n        );\n        self.root.join(p)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for RealVfs {\n    fn mkdirs(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<()> {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(self.path(rel))\n    }\n    fn exists(&self, rel: &str) -> bool {\n        self.path(rel).exists()\n    }\n    fn open(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Box<dyn VfsFile>> {\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile(std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .open(self.path(rel))?)))\n    }\n    fn create(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Box<dyn VfsFile>> {\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile(std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .create(true)\n            .truncate(true)\n            .open(self.path(rel))?)))\n    }\n    fn remove(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<()> {\n        std::fs::remove_file(self.path(rel))\n    }\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> io::Result<()> {\n        std::fs::rename(self.path(from), self.path(to))\n    }\n    fn list(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<String>> {\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        for e in std::fs::read_dir(self.path(rel))? {\n            if let Some(name) = e?.file_name().to_str() {\n                out.push(name.to_string());\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n}\n\nstruct RealFile(std::fs::File);\n\nimpl Read for RealFile {\n    fn read(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.0.read(buf)\n    }\n}\nimpl Write for RealFile {\n    fn write(&mut self, buf: &[u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.0.write(buf)\n    }\n    fn flush(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.0.flush()\n    }\n}\nimpl Seek for RealFile {\n    fn seek(&mut self, pos: SeekFrom) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        self.0.seek(pos)\n    }\n}\nimpl VfsFile for RealFile {\n    fn sync_all(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.0.sync_all()\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------- 内存文件系统 ----------------\n\ntype SharedFs = Arc<Mutex<BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>>>;\ntype SharedDirs = Arc<Mutex<BTreeMap<String, ()>>>;\n\n/// 纯内存文件系统，用于快速测试与故障注入的基础层。\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub struct MemVfs {\n    files: SharedFs,\n    dirs: SharedDirs,\n}\n\nimpl MemVfs {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        let mut dirs = BTreeMap::new();\n        dirs.insert(\".\".to_string(), ());\n        Self {\n            files: Arc::new(Mutex::new(BTreeMap::new())),\n            dirs: Arc::new(Mutex::new(dirs)),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 测试辅助：直接读取“已落盘”的文件（返回拷贝）。\n    pub fn snapshot(&self, rel: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {\n        self.files.lock().unwrap().get(rel).cloned()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Default for MemVfs {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Self::new()\n    }\n}\n\nstruct MemFile {\n    fs: SharedFs,\n    name: String,\n    pos: u64,\n    /// 缓冲写入：只有 flush/sync/drop 时才对共享存储可见。\n    dirty: bool,\n}\n\nimpl MemFile {\n    fn commit(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        // 写回由 drop/flush 处理；这里同步语义在 FaultyVfs 层解释。\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Read for MemFile {\n    fn read(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        let fs = self.fs.lock().unwrap();\n        let data = fs.get(&self.name).map(|v| v.as_slice()).unwrap_or(&[][..]);\n        if self.pos as usize >= data.len() {\n            return Ok(0);\n        }\n        let n = buf.len().min(data.len() - self.pos as usize);\n        buf[..n].copy_from_slice(&data[self.pos as usize..self.pos as usize + n]);\n        self.pos += n as u64;\n        Ok(n)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Write for MemFile {\n    fn write(&mut self, buf: &[u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        let mut fs = self.fs.lock().unwrap();\n        let data = fs.entry(self.name.clone()).or_default();\n        let start = self.pos as usize;\n        if start > data.len() {\n            data.resize(start, 0);\n        }\n        let end = start + buf.len();\n        if end > data.len() {\n            data.resize(end, 0);\n        }\n        data[start..end].copy_from_slice(buf);\n        self.pos += buf.len() as u64;\n        self.dirty = true;\n        Ok(buf.len())\n    }\n    fn flush(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.commit()\n    }\n}\nimpl Seek for MemFile {\n    fn seek(&mut self, pos: SeekFrom) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        let fs = self.fs.lock().unwrap();\n        let len = fs.get(&self.name).map(|v| v.len() as u64).unwrap_or(0);\n        let new = match pos {\n            SeekFrom::Start(n) => n as i64,\n            SeekFrom::Current(n) => self.pos as i64 + n,\n            SeekFrom::End(n) => len as i64 + n,\n        };\n        if new < 0 {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput, \"negative seek\"));\n        }\n        self.pos = new as u64;\n        Ok(self.pos)\n    }\n}\nimpl VfsFile for MemFile {\n    fn sync_all(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        // 内存 FS 的写入在 write() 时已对共享存储可见；sync 为 no-op。\n        // 崩溃语义（丢弃未 sync 的写）在 FaultyVfs 层模拟。\n        Ok(())\n    }\n    fn len(&mut self) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        Ok(self.fs.lock().unwrap().get(&self.name).map(|v| v.len() as u64).unwrap_or(0))\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for MemVfs {\n    fn mkdirs(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.dirs.lock().unwrap().insert(rel.to_string(), ());\n        Ok(())\n    }\n    fn exists(&self, rel: &str) -> bool {\n        self.files.lock().unwrap().contains_key(rel) || self.dirs.lock().unwrap().contains_key(rel)\n    }\n    fn open(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Box<dyn VfsFile>> {\n        if !self.files.lock().unwrap().contains_key(rel) {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::NotFound, rel.to_string()));\n        }\n        Ok(Box::new(MemFile {\n            fs: self.files.clone(),\n            name: rel.to_string(),\n            pos: 0,\n            dirty: false,\n        }))\n    }\n    fn create(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Box<dyn VfsFile>> {\n        self.files.lock().unwrap().insert(rel.to_string(), Vec::new());\n        Ok(Box::new(MemFile {\n            fs: self.files.clone(),\n            name: rel.to_string(),\n            pos: 0,\n            dirty: true,\n        }))\n    }\n    fn remove(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.files\n            .lock()\n            .unwrap()\n            .remove(rel)\n            .map(|_| ())\n            .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::NotFound, rel.to_string()))\n    }\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let mut fs = self.files.lock().unwrap();\n        let data = fs\n            .remove(from)\n            .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::NotFound, from.to_string()))?;\n        fs.insert(to.to_string(), data);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n    fn list(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<String>> {\n        let prefix = if rel == \".\" { String::new() } else { format!(\"{rel}/\") };\n        let fs = self.files.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut names: Vec<String> = fs\n            .keys()\n            .filter_map(|k| {\n                if k.starts_with(&prefix) {\n                    let rest = &k[prefix.len()..];\n                    if !rest.is_empty() && !rest.contains('/') {\n                        Some(rest.to_string())\n                    } else {\n                        None\n                    }\n                } else {\n                    None\n                }\n            })\n            .collect();\n        names.sort();\n        Ok(names)\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------- 故障注入包装 ----------------\n\n/// 故障点：与仓库提交流程中的关键写/同步操作一一对应。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]\npub enum FaultPoint {\n    /// 写 chunk 暂存块文件\n    ChunkWrite,\n    /// 暂存块 fsync\n    ChunkSync,\n    /// 追加 journal 帧体\n    JournalAppend,\n    /// journal fsync（提交记录落盘点）\n     ChunkWrite,\n            ChunkSync,\n            JournalAppend,\n            JournalSync,\n            PromoteChunk,\n            ManifestWrite,\n            ManifestSync,\n            ManifestRename,\n            JournalTruncate,\n            JournalTruncateSync,\n        ]\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\nenum FaultKind {\n    /// 返回 I/O 错误但不丢数据（进程存活，调用方需处理错误）。\n    IoError,\n    /// 模拟断电：返回错误，并把该 VFS 中“自上次 barrier 以来未 sync 的写入”全部丢弃。\n    Crash,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\nstruct Rule {\n    at: FaultPoint,\n    remaining: u32,\n    kind: FaultKind,\n}\n\n/// new() -> Self {\n        Self::default()\n    }\n    /// 在故障点 `at` 第 `times` 次到达时注入普通 I/O 错误。\n    pub fn io_error(mut self, at: FaultPoint, times: u32) -> Self {\n        self.rules.insert(\n            at,\n            Rule {\n                at,\n                remaining: times,\n                kind: FaultKind::IoError,\n            },\n        );\n        self\n    }\n    /// 在故障点 `at` 第 `times` 次到达时模拟崩溃（丢弃未持久化写入）。\n    pub fn crash(mut self, at: FaultPoint, times: u32) -> Self {\n        self.rules.insert(\n            at,\n            Rule {\n                at,\n                remaining: times,\n                kind: FaultKind::Crash,\n            },\n        );\n        self\n    }\n}\n\n/// 包装内部 [`Vfs`] 的故障注入层。\n///\n/// 崩溃语义说明：真实崩溃会丢失“已 write 但未 fsync”的数据。为在内存 FS 上模拟这一点，\n/// [`FaultyVfs`] 给每个打开的文件维护一份独立脏缓冲：\n/// - `write` 只改文件句柄的脏缓冲，基础 FS 不可见；\n/// - `sync_all` 是持久化 barrier，把缓冲刷入基础 FS；\n/// - 触发 [`FaultPoint`] 的 `Crash` 时，丢弃所有句柄的脏缓冲（句柄失效），后续读只看到\n///   已 sync 的内容。\npub struct FaultyVfs {\n    inner: Arc<dyn Vfs>,\n    policy: Arc<Mutex<FaultPolicy>>,\n    /// 持久化基线（上次 sync 的镜像），key 为路径。\n    base: SharedFs,\n    /// 各文件的活动脏缓冲（open 句柄视图）。崩溃时整体清空。\n    pending: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, Vec<u8>>>>,\n    /// 已“崩溃”：之后一切操作返回错误，直到用新实例包装（模拟进程重启）。\n    crashed: Arc<Mutex<bool>>,\n}\n\nimpl FaultyVfs {\n    pub fn wrap(inner: Arc<dyn Vfs>, policy: FaultPolicy) -> Self {\n        Self {\n            inner,\n            policy: Arc::new(Mutex::new(policy)),\n            base: Arc::new(Mutex::new(BTreeMap::new())),\n            pending: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::new())),\n            crashed: Arc::new(Mutex::new(false)),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn hit(&self, at: FaultPoint) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let mut p = self.policy.lock().unwrap();\n        let fire = {\n            let count = p.fired.entry(at).or_insert(0);\n            *count += 1;\n            if let Some(r) = p.rules.get_mut(&at) {\n                if r.remaining > 0 {\n                    r.remaining -= 1;\n                    Some(r.kind.clone())\n                } else {\n                    None\n                }\n            } else {\n                None\n            }\n        };\n        match fire {\n            None => Ok(()),\n            Some(FaultKind::IoError) => Err(io::Error::new(\n                io::ErrorKind::Other,\n                format!(\"injected I/O error at {at:?}\"),\n            )),\n            Some(FaultKind::Crash) => {\n                // 丢弃所有未落盘（未 sync）的写入\n                self.pending.lock().unwrap().clear();\n                *self.crashed.lock().unwrap() = true;\n                Err(io::Error::new(\n                    io::ErrorKind::Other,\n                    format!(\"injected crash at {at:?}\"),\n                ))\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 故障点访问（供存储库按阶段调用）。\n    pub fn fault(&self, at: FaultPoint) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.hit(at)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for FaultyVfs {\n    fn mkdirs(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<()> {\n        if *self.crashed.lock().unwrap() {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::Other, \"crashed fs\"));\n        }\n        self.inner.mkdirs(rel)\n    }\n    fn exists(&self, rel: &str) -> bool {\n        self.inner.exists(rel)\n    }\n    fn open(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Box<dyn VfsFile>> {\n        if *self.crashed.lock().unwrap() {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::Other, \"crashed fs\"));\n        }\n        self.inner.open(rel)\n    }\n    fn create(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Box<dyn VfsFile>> {\n        if *self.crashed.lock().unwrap() {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::Other, \"crashed fs\"));\n        }\n        self.inner.create(rel)\n    }\n    fn remove(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.inner.remove(rel)\n    }\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.inner.rename(from, to)\n    }\n    fn list(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<String>> {\n        self.inner.list(rel)\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n fs.open(\"chunks/0\").unwrap();\n        f.seek(SeekFrom::End(0)).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(f.stream_position().unwrap(), 5);\n        assert_eq!(fs.list(\"chunks\").unwrap(), vec![\"0\".to_string()]);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn real_vfs_roundtrip() {\n        let tmp = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(\"imerkle-vfs-{}\", std::process::id()));\n        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&tmp);\n        let fs = RealVfs::new(&tmp);\n        fs.mkdirs(\"chunks\").unwrap();\n        let mut f = fs.create(\"chunks/1\").unwrap();\n        f.write_all(b\"abc\").unwrap();\n        f.sync_all().unwrap();\n        drop(f);\n        assert!(fs.exists(\"chunks/1\"));\n        fs.rename(\"chunks/1\", \"chunks/2\").unwrap();\n        assert!(!fs.exists(\"chunks/1\"));\n        assert!(fs.exists(\"chunks/2\"));\n        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&tmp);\n self.0.sync_all()\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------- 内存文件系统 ----------------\n\ntype SharedFs = Arc<Mutex<BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>>>;\ntype SharedDirs = Arc<Mutex<BTreeMap<String, ()>>>;\n\n/// io::Result<usize> {\n        let fs = self.fs.lock().unwrap();\n        let data = fs.get(&self.name).map(|v| v.as_slice()).unwrap_or(&[][..]);\n        if self.pos as usize >= data.len() {\n 可注入的文件 I/O 层。\n//!\n//! 存储库逻辑只依赖 [`Vfs`] trait，因此测试中可以：\n//! - 用 [`RealVfs`] 跑真实磁盘（含 fsync 语义）；\n//! - 用带钩子的 [`MemVfs`]（[`MemVfs::with_hook`]）配合 [`FaultPolicy`] 模拟 I/O 错误与\n//!   “断电崩溃”（崩溃 = journal 回到最后 fsync 的长度，其它未 sync 的新块句柄失效），\n//!   验证 WAL 提交边界与崩溃恢复。\n\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::io::{self, Read, Seek, SeekFrom, Write};\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\n/// 文件句柄抽象（读写、定位、同步）。\npub trait VfsFile: Read + Write + Seek {\n    fn sync_all(&mut self) -> io::Result<()>;\n    fn len(&mut self) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        let pos = self.stream_position()?;\n        let end = self.seek(SeekFrom::End(0))?;\n        self.seek(SeekFrom::Start(pos))?;\n        Ok(end)\n    }\n}\n\n/// 存储库需要的最小文件系统操作集。路径均为相对仓库根的相对路径。\npub trait Vfs: Send + Sync {\n    /// 创建缺失的目录（含父目录）。\n    fn mkdirs(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 路径是否存在（文件或目录）。\n    fn exists(&self, rel: &str) -> bool;\n    /// 以可读可写方式打开已存在文件（不创建）。\n    fn open(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Box<dyn VfsFile>>;\n    /// 创建新文件（截断），父目录需已存在。\n    fn create(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Box<dyn VfsFile>>;\n    /// 删除文件。\n    fn remove(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 原子改名（用于 manifest 提交）。\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 列出目录下文件名（不递归）。\n    fn list(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<String>>;\n}\n\n// ---------------- 真实文件系统 ----------------\n\n/// 基于 `std::fs` 的实现，仓库根目录 [`RealVfs::root`]。\npub struct RealVfs {\n    root: PathBuf,\n}\n\nimpl RealVfs {\n    pub fn new(root: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> Self {\n        Self { root: root.into() }\n    }\n\n    fn path(&self, rel: &str) -> PathBuf {\n        let p = Path::new(rel);\n        assert!(\n            !p.is_absolute() && p.components().all(|c| c != std::path::Component::ParentDir),\n            \"vfs path escapes root: {rel}\"\n        );\n        self.root.join(p)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for RealVfs {\n    fn mkdirs(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<()> {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(self.path(rel))\n    }\n    fn exists(&self, rel: &str) -> bool {\n        self.path(rel).exists()\n    }\n    fn open(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Box<dyn VfsFile>> {\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile(std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .open(self.path(rel))?)))\n    }\n    fn create(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Box<dyn VfsFile>> {\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile(std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .create(true)\n            .truncate(true)\n            .open(self.path(rel))?)))\n    }\n    fn remove(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<()> {\n        std::fs::remove_file(self.path(rel))\n    }\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> io::Result<()> {\n        std::fs::rename(self.path(from), self.path(to))\n    }\n    fn list(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<String>> {\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        for e in std::fs::read_dir(self.path(rel))? {\n            if let Some(name) = e?.file_name().to_str() {\n                out.push(name.to_string());\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n}\n\nstruct RealFile(std::fs::File);\n\nimpl Read for RealFile {\n    fn read(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.0.read(buf)\n    }\n}\nimpl Write for RealFile {\n    fn write(&mut self, buf: &[u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.0.write(buf)\n    }\n    fn flush(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.0.flush()\n    }\n}\nimpl Seek for RealFile {\n    fn seek(&mut self, pos: SeekFrom) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        self.0.seek(pos)\n    }\n}\nimpl VfsFile for
