io::Result<()> + Send + Sync>;\n\n/// [`MemVfs`] 操作类别，钩子可据此在特定文件/动作上注入错误。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum VfsOp<'a> {\n    Create { path: &'a str },\n    Open { path: &'a str },\n    Write { path: &'a str },\n    Sync { path: &'a str },\n    Rename { from: &'a str, to: &'a str },\n    Remove { path: &'a str },\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone)]\nenum HookEvent {\n    Create(String),\n    Open(String),\n    Write(String),\n    Sync(String),\n    Rename(String, String),\n    Remove(String),\n}\n\nimpl HookEvent {\n    fn op(&self) -> VfsOp<'_> {\n        match self {\n            HookEvent::Create(p) => VfsOp::Create { path: p },\n            HookEvent::Open(p) => VfsOp::Open { path: p },\n            HookEvent::Write(p) => VfsOp::Write { path: p },\n            HookEvent::Sync(p) => VfsOp::Sync { path: p },\n            HookEvent::Rename(f, t) => VfsOp::Rename { from: f, to: t },\n            HookEvent::Remove(p) => VfsOp::Remove { path: p },\n        }\n    }\n}\n\ntype SharedFs = Arc<Mutex<BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>>>;\ntype SharedDirs = Arc<Mutex<BTreeMap<String, ()>>>;\ntype SharedHook = Arc<Mutex<Option<Hook>>>;\n\n/// 纯内存文件系统。写入在 `write()` 时即对共享存储生效（无页缓存建模）；\n/// `sync_all` 是持久化 barrier，崩溃模拟时通过钩子把文件截断到“最后 sync 的长度”。\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub struct MemVfs {\n    files: SharedFs,\n    dirs: SharedDirs,\n    hook: SharedHook,\n    /// 每个文件最后一次 sync 时的长度；崩溃后恢复到这些长度。\n    sync_len: Arc<Mutex<BTreeMap<String, u64>>>,\n}\n\nimpl MemVfs {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        let mut dirs = BTreeMap::new();\n        dirs.insert(\".\".to_string(), ());\n        Self {\n            files: Arc::new(Mutex::new(BTreeMap::new())),\n            dirs: Arc::new(Mutex::new(dirs)),\n            hook: Arc::new(Mutex::new(None)),\n            sync_len: Arc::new(Mutex::new(BTreeMap::new())),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 挂载操作钩子。钩子返回 Err 时该操作失败（但不影响已写入的共享状态）。\n    pub fn with_hook<F>(self, hook: F) -> Self\n    where\n        F: Fn(VfsOp) -> io::Result<()> + Send + Sync + 'static,\n    {\n        *self.hook.lock().unwrap() = Some(Arc::new(hook));\n        self\n    }\n\n    fn fire(&self, ev: &HookEvent) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let h = self.hook.lock().unwrap();\n        if let Some(f) = h.as_ref() {\n            f(ev.op())\n        } else {\n            Ok(())\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 模拟断电：把所有文件截断回最后 `sync_all` 时的长度（未 sync 的尾部丢失），\n    /// 并删除从未 sync 过的文件。\n    pub fn simulate_crash(&self) {\n        let mut fs = self.files.lock().unwrap();\n        let lens = self.sync_len.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut to_remove = Vec::new();\n        for (path, data) in fs.iter_mut() {\n            match lens.get(path) {\n                Some(&len) => data.truncate(len as usize),\n                None => to_remove.push(path.clone()),\n            }\n        }\n        for p in to_remove {\n            fs.remove(&p);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 测试辅助：直接读取文件内容（拷贝）。\n    pub fn snapshot(&self, rel: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {\n        self.files.lock().unwrap().get(rel).cloned()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Default for MemVfs {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Self::new()\n    }\n}\n\nstruct MemFile {\n    fs: SharedFs,\n    name: String,\n    pos: u64,\n    on_sync: Arc<dyn Fn(&str) + Send + Sync>,\n    on_write: Arc<dyn Fn(&str) -> io::Result<()> + Send + Sync>,\n}\n\nimpl Read for MemFile {\n    fn read(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        let fs = self.fs.lock().unwrap();\n        let data = fs.get(&self.name).map(|v| v.as_slice()).unwrap_or(&[][..]);\n        if self.pos as usize >= data.len() {\n            return Ok(0);\n        }\n        let n = buf.len().min(data.len() - self.pos as usize);\n        buf[..n].copy_from_slice(&data[self.pos as usize..self.pos as usize + n]);\n        self.pos += n as u64;\n        Ok(n)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Write for MemFile {\n    fn write(&mut self, buf: &[u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        (self.on_write)(&self.name)?;\n        let mut fs = self.fs.lock().unwrap();\n        let data = fs.entry(self.name.clone()).or_default();\n        let start = self.pos as usize;\n        if start > data.len() {\n            data.resize(start, 0);\n        }\n        let end = start + buf.len();\n        if end > data.len() {\n            data.resize(end, 0);\n        }\n        data[start..end].copy_from_slice(buf);\n        self.pos += buf.len() as u64;\n        Ok(buf.len())\n    }\n    fn flush(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\nimpl Seek for MemFile {\n    fn seek(&mut self, pos: SeekFrom) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        let fs = self.fs.lock().unwrap();\n        let len = fs.get(&self.name).map(|v| v.len() as u64).unwrap_or(0);\n        let new = match pos {\n            SeekFrom::Start(n) => n as i64,\n            SeekFrom::Current(n) => self.pos as i64 + n,\n            SeekFrom::End(n) => len as i64 + n,\n        };\n        if new < 0 {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput, \"negative seek\"));\n        }\n        self.pos = new as u64;\n        Ok(self.pos)\n    }\n}\nimpl VfsFile for MemFile {\n    fn sync_all(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        (self.on_sync)(&self.name);\n        let len = self.fs.lock().unwrap().get(&self.name).map(|v| v.len() as u64).unwrap_or(0);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n    fn len(&mut self) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        Ok(self.fs.lock().unwrap().get(&self.name).map(|v| v.len() as u64).unwrap_or(0))\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for MemVfs {\n    fn mkdirs(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.dirs.lock().unwrap().insert(rel.to_string(), ());\n        Ok(())\n    }\n    fn exists(&self, rel: &str) -> bool {\n        self.files.lock().unwrap().contains_key(rel) || self.dirs.lock().unwrap().contains_key(rel)\n    }\n    fn open(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Box<dyn VfsFile>> {\n        self.fire(&HookEvent::Open(rel.to_string()))?;\n        if !self.files.lock().unwrap().contains_key(rel) {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::NotFound, rel.to_string()));\n        }\n        let fs = self.files.clone();\n        let name = rel.to_string();\n        let on_sync = {\n            let sync_len = self.sync_len.clone();\n            Arc::new(move |p: &str| {\n                let len = fs.lock().unwrap().get(p).map(|v| v.len() as u64).unwrap_or(0);\n                sync_len.lock().unwrap().insert(p.to_string(), len);\n            })\n        };\n        let hook = self.hook.clone();\n        let on_write = Arc::new(move |p: &str| -> io::Result<()> {\n            let h = hook.lock().unwrap();\n            if let Some(f) = h.as_ref() {\n                f(VfsOp::Write { path: p })?;\n            }\n            Ok(())\n        });\n        Ok(Box::new(MemFile {\n            fs: self.files.clone(),\n            name,\n            pos: 0,\n            on_sync,\n            on_write,\n        }))\n    }\n    fn create(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Box<dyn VfsFile>> {\n        self.fire(&HookEvent::Create(rel.to_string()))?;\n        self.files.lock().unwrap().insert(rel.to_string(), Vec::new());\n        self.sync_len.lock().unwrap().remove(rel);\n        let fs = self.files.clone();\n        let name = rel.to_string();\n        let on_sync = {\n            let sync_len = self.sync_len.clone();\n            Arc::new(move |p: &str| {\n                let len = fs.lock().unwrap().get(p).map(|v| v.len() as u64).unwrap_or(0);\n                sync_len.lock().unwrap().insert(p.to_string(), len);\n            })\n        };\n        let hook = self.hook.clone();\n        let on_write = Arc::new(move |p: &str| -> io::Result<()> {\n            let h = hook.lock().unwrap();\n            if let Some(f) = h.as_ref() {\n                f(VfsOp::Write { path: p })?;\n            }\n            Ok(())\n        });\n        Ok(Box::new(MemFile {\n            fs: self.files.clone(),\n            name,\n            pos: 0,\n            on_sync,\n            on_write,\n        }))\n    }\n    fn remove(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.fire(&HookEvent::Remove(rel.to_string()))?;\n        self.files.lock().unwrap().remove(rel);\n        self.sync_len.lock().unwrap().remove(rel);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n data = fs\n            .remove(from)\n            .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::NotFound, from.to_string()))?;\n        fs.insert(to.to_string(), data);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n    fn list(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<String>> {\n        let prefix = if rel == \".\" { String::new() } else { format!(\"{rel}/\") };\n        let fs = self.files.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut names: Vec<String> = fs\n            .keys()\n            .filter_map(|k| {\n                if k.starts_with(&prefix) {\n                    let rest = &k[prefix.len()..];\n                    if !rest.is_empty() && !rest.contains('/') {\n                        Some(rest.to_string())\n                    } else {\n                        None\n                    }\n                } else {\n                    None\n                }\n            })\n            .collect();\n        names.sort();\n        Ok(names)\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------- 故障点与策略 ----------------\n\n/// 故障点：与仓库提交流程中的关键阶段一一对应（语义见 store.rs 提交流程注释）。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]\npub enum FaultPoint {\n    /// 写 chunk 暂存块文件\n    ChunkWrite,\n    /// 暂存块 fsync\n    ChunkSync,\n    /// 追加 journal 帧体\n    JournalAppend,\n    /// journal fsync（提交记录落盘点）\n    JournalSync,\n    /// 暂存块提升为正式块\n    PromoteChunk,\n    /// 写 manifest.tmp\n    ManifestWrite,\n    /// manifest.tmp fsync\n    ManifestSync,\n    /// manifest rename\n    ManifestRename,\n    /// 删除/截断 journal\n    JournalTruncate,\n    /// journal 截断后 fsync\n    JournalTruncateSync,\n}\n\nimpl FaultPoint {\n    pub fn all() -> [FaultPoint; 10] {\n        use FaultPoint::*;\n        [\n            ChunkWrite,\n            ChunkSync,\n            JournalAppend,\n            JournalSync,\n            PromoteChunk,\n            ManifestWrite,\n            ManifestSync,\n            ManifestRename,\n            JournalTruncate,\n            JournalTruncateSync,\n        ]\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\nenum FaultKind {\n    /// 返回 I/O 错误但不丢数据（进程存活，调用方收到错误后重开恢复）。\n    IoError,\n    /// 模拟断电：返回错误，并把文件系统截断到最后 sync 状态。\n    Crash,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\nstruct Rule {\n    remaining: u32,\n    kind: FaultKind,\n}\n\n/// 故障注入策略（线程安全共享）。每个故障点可配置“第 N 次命中时故障”。\n#[derive(Default)]\npub struct FaultPolicy {\n    rules: std::collections::HashMap<FaultPoint, Rule>,\n    /// 每个故障点累计命中次数。\n    pub fired: std::collections::HashMap<FaultPoint, u32>,\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Debug for FaultPolicy {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        f.debug_struct(\"FaultPolicy\")\n            .field(\"rules\", &self.rules)\n            .field(\"fired\", &self.fired)\n            .finish()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl FaultPolicy {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        Self::default()\n    }\n    /// 在故障点 `at` 第 `times` 次到达时注入普通 I/O 错误（默认第 1 次）。\n    pub fn io_error(mut self, at: FaultPoint, times: u32) -> Self {\n        self.rules.insert(at, Rule { remaining: times, kind: FaultKind::IoError });\n        self\n    }\n    /// 在故障点 `at` 第 `times` 次到达时模拟崩溃。\n    pub fn crash(mut self, at: FaultPoint, times: u32) -> Self {\n        self.rules.insert(at, Rule { remaining: times, kind: FaultKind::Crash });\n        self\n    }\n\n    /// 命中故障点。返回 Ok 表示放行；Err 表示注入的故障。\n    /// 对 `Crash` 类型，调用 `on_crash` 回调（由测试装配为 [`MemVfs::simulate_crash`]）。\n    pub(crate) fn hit(\n        &mut self,\n        at: FaultPoint,\n        on_crash: &dyn Fn(),\n    ) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let count = self.fired.entry(at).or_insert(0);\n        *count += 1;\n        if let Some(r) = self.rules.get_mut(&at) {\n            if r.remaining > 0 {\n                r.remaining -= 1;\n                return match r.kind {\n                    FaultKind::IoError => Err(io::Error::new(\n                        io::ErrorKind::Other,\n                        format!(\"injected I/O error at {at:?}\"),\n                    )),\n                    FaultKind::Crash => {\n                        on_crash();\n                        Err(io::Error::new(\n                            io::ErrorKind::Other,\n                            format!(\"injected crash at {at:?}\"),\n                        ))\n                    }\n                };\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn mem_vfs_basic_io() {\n        let fs: Arc<dyn Vfs> = Arc::new(MemVfs::new());\n assert!(fs.exists(\"chunks/0\"));\n        let mut f = fs.open(\"chunks/0\").unwrap();\n        f.seek(SeekFrom::End(0)).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(f.stream_position().unwrap(), 5);\n        assert_eq!(fs.list(\"chunks\").unwrap(), vec![\"0\".to_string()]);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn crash_truncates_unsynced_tail() {\n        let mem = MemVfs::new();\n        let fs: Arc<dyn Vfs> = Arc::new(mem.clone());\n        let mut f = fs.create(\"journal\").unwrap();\n        f.write_all(b\"committed-part\").unwrap();\n        f.sync_all().unwrap();\n        f.write_all(b\"torn-tail\").unwrap(); // 未 sync\n        drop(f);\n        let mut g = fs.create(\"brand-new\").unwrap();\n        g.write_all(b\"unsynced new file\").unwrap(); // 整个文件未 sync\n        drop(g);\n\n        mem.simulate_crash();\n\n        assert_eq!(mem.snapshot(\"journal\").unwrap(), b\"committed-part\");\n        assert!(mem.snapshot(\"brand-new\").is_none());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn hook_injects_write_error() {\n        let mem = MemVfs::new().with_hook(|op| match op {\n            VfsOp::Write { path } if path == \"x\" => {\n                Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::Other, \"disk full\"))\n            }\n            _ => Ok(()),\n        });\n        let fs: Arc<dyn Vfs> = Arc::new(mem);\n        let mut f = fs.create(\"x\").unwrap();\n        assert!(f.write_all(b\"a\").is_err());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn real_vfs_roundtrip() {\n        let tmp = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(\"imerkle-vfs-{}\", std::process::id()));\n        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&tmp);\n        let fs = RealVfs::new(&tmp);\n        fs.mkdirs(\"chunks\").unwrap();\n        let mut f = fs.create(\"chunks/1\").unwrap();\n        f.write_all(b\"abc\").unwrap();\n        f.sync_all().unwrap();\n        drop(f);\n        assert!(fs.exists(\"chunks/1\"));\n        fs.rename(\"chunks/1\", \"chunks/2\").unwrap();\n        assert!(!fs.exists(\"chunks/1\"));\n        assert!(fs.exists(\"chunks/2\"));\n        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&tmp);\n 可注入的文件 I/O 层。\n//!\n//! 存储库逻辑只依赖 [`Vfs`] trait，因此测试中可以：\n//! - 用 [`RealVfs`] 跑真实磁盘（含 fsync 语义）；\n//! - 用带钩子的 [`MemVfs`]（[`MemVfs::with_hook`]）配合 [`FaultPolicy`] 模拟 I/O 错误与\n//!   “断电崩溃”（崩溃 = journal 回到最后 fsync 的长度，其它未 sync 的新块句柄失效），\n//!   验证 WAL 提交边界与崩溃恢复。\n\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::io::{self, Read, Seek, SeekFrom, Write};\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\n/// 文件句柄抽象（读写、定位、同步）。\npub trait VfsFile: Read + Write + Seek {\n    fn sync_all(&mut self) -> io::Result<()>;\n    fn len(&mut self) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        let pos = self.stream_position()?;\n        let end = self.seek(SeekFrom::End(0))?;\n        self.seek(SeekFrom::Start(pos))?;\n        Ok(end)\n    }\n}\n\n/// 存储库需要的最小文件系统操作集。路径均为相对仓库根的相对路径。\npub trait Vfs: Send + Sync {\n    /// 创建缺失的目录（含父目录）。\n    fn mkdirs(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 路径是否存在（文件或目录）。\n    fn exists(&self, rel: &str) -> bool;\n    /// 以可读可写方式打开已存在文件（不创建）。\n    fn open(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Box<dyn VfsFile>>;\n    /// 创建新文件（截断），父目录需已存在。\n    fn create(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Box<dyn VfsFile>>;\n    /// 删除文件。\n    fn remove(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 原子改名（用于 manifest 提交）。\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 列出目录下文件名（不递归）。\n    fn list(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<String>>;\n}\n\n// ---------------- 真实文件系统 ----------------\n\n/// 基于 `std::fs` 的实现，仓库根目录 [`RealVfs::root`]。\npub struct RealVfs {\n    root: PathBuf,\n}\n\nimpl RealVfs {\n    pub fn new(root: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> Self {\n        Self { root: root.into() }\n    }\n\n    fn path(&self, rel: &str) -> PathBuf {\n        let p = Path::new(rel);\n        assert!(\n            !p.is_absolute() && p.components().all(|c| c != std::path::Component::ParentDir),\n            \"vfs path escapes root: {rel}\"\n        );\n        self.root.join(p)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for RealVfs {\n    fn mkdirs(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<()> {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(self.path(rel))\n    }\n    fn exists(&self, rel: &str) -> bool {\n        self.path(rel).exists()\n    }\n    fn open(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Box<dyn VfsFile>> {\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile(std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .open(self.path(rel))?)))\n    }\n    fn create(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Box<dyn VfsFile>> {\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile(std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .create(true)\n            .truncate(true)\n            .open(self.path(rel))?)))\n    }\n    fn remove(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<()> {\n        std::fs::remove_file(self.path(rel))\n    }\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> io::Result<()> {\n        std::fs::rename(self.path(from), self.path(to))\n    }\n    fn list(&self, rel: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<String>> {\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        for e in std::fs::read_dir(self.path(rel))? {\n            if let Some(name) = e?.file_name().to_str() {\n                out.push(name.to_string());\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n}\n\nstruct RealFile(std::fs::File);\n\nimpl Read for RealFile {\n    fn read(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.0.read(buf)\n    }\n}\nimpl Write for RealFile {\n    fn write(&mut self, buf: &[u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.0.write(buf)\n    }\n    fn flush(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.0.flush()\n    }\n}\nimpl Seek for RealFile {\n    fn seek(&mut self, pos: SeekFrom) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        self.0.seek(pos)\n    }\n}\nimpl VfsFile for RealFile {\n    fn sync_all(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.0.sync_all()\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------- 内存文件系统（可挂故障钩子） ----------------\n\ntype Hook = Arc<dyn Fn(VfsOp) -> io::Result<()> + Send + Sync>;\n\n/// [`MemVfs`] 操作类别，钩子可据此在特定文件/动作上注入错误。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum VfsOp<'a> {\n    Create { path: &'a str },\n    Open { path: &'a str },\n    Write { path: &'a str },\n    Sync { path: &'a str },\n    Rename { from: &'a str, to: &'a str },\n    Remove { path: &'a str },\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone)]\nenum HookEvent {\n    Create(String),\n    Open(String),\n    Write(String),\n    Sync(String),\n    Rename(String, String),\n    Remove(String),\n}\n\nimpl HookEvent {\n    fn op(&self) -> VfsOp<'_> {\n        match self {\n            HookEvent::Create(p) => VfsOp::Create { path: p },\n            HookEvent::Open(p) => VfsOp::Open { path: p },\n            HookEvent::Write(p) => VfsOp::Write { path: p },\n            HookEvent::Sync(p) => VfsOp::Sync { path: p },\n            HookEvent::Rename(f, t) => VfsOp::Rename { from: f, to: t },\n            HookEvent::Remove(p) => VfsOp::Remove { path: p },\n        }\n    }\n}\n\ntype SharedFs = Arc<Mutex<BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>>>;\ntype SharedDirs = Arc<Mutex<BTreeMap<String, ()>>>;\ntype SharedHook = Arc<Mutex<Option<Hook>>>;\n\n/// 纯内存文件系统。写入在 `write()` 时即对共享存储生效（无页缓存建模）；\n/// `sync_all` 是持久化 barrier，崩溃模拟时通过钩子把文件截断到“最后 sync 的长度”。\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub struct MemVfs {\n    files: SharedFs,\n    dirs: SharedDirs,\n    hook: SharedHook,\n    /// 每个文件最后一次 sync 时的长度；崩溃后恢复到这些长度。\n    sync_len: Arc<Mutex<BTreeMap<String, u64>>>,\n}\n\nimpl MemVfs {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        let mut dirs = BTreeMap::new();\n        dirs.insert(\".\".to_string(), ());\n        Self {\n            files: Arc::new(Mutex::new(BTreeMap::new())),\n            dirs: Arc::new(Mutex::new(dirs)),\n            hook: Arc::new(Mutex::new(None)),\n            sync_len: Arc::new(Mutex::new(BTreeMap::new())),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 挂载操作钩子。钩子返回 Err 时该操作失败（但不影响已写入的共享状态）。\n    pub fn with_hook<F>(self, hook: F) -> Self\n    where\n        F: Fn(VfsOp) -> io::Result<()> + Send + Sync + 'static,\n    {\n        *self.hook.lock().unwrap() = Some(Arc::new(hook));\n        self\n    }\n\n    fn fire(&self, ev: &HookEvent) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let h = self.hook.lock().unwrap();\n        if let Some(f) = h.as_ref() {\n            f(ev.op())\n        } else {\n            Ok(())\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 模拟断电：把所有文件截断回最后 `sync_all` 时的长度（未 sync 的尾部丢失），\n    /// 并删除从未 sync 过的文件。\n    pub fn simulate_crash(&self) {\n        let mut fs = self.files.lock().unwrap();\n        let lens = 文件支持的存储库：磁盘格式、WAL 提交协议、崩溃恢复与增量 Merkle 更新。\n//!\n//! # 磁盘布局\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! <repo>/\n//! ├── manifest.json        # 已提交状态快照（JSON, 见 ManifestState）\n//! ├── journal              # 前滚 WAL：帧序列 IMRKJRN1 || len || payload || sha256(payload)\n//! ├── chunks/              # 正式块：chunks/<块序号>，内容即原始块字节\n//! └── tmp/\n//!     └── staging/         # 提交暂存块：tmp/staging/<块序号>\n//! ```\n//!\n//! # manifest.json\n//!\n//! ```json\n//! {\n//!   \"version\": 3,\n//!   \"chunk_size\": 4096,\n//!   \"file_length\": 12300,\n//!   \"chunk_count\": 4,\n//!   \"root\": \"<hex sha256>\"\n//! }\n//! ```\n//!\n//! `root` 由块内容与协议参数派生（冗余存储仅用于打开时自检）。\n//!\n//! # journal 帧\n//!\n//! | 偏移 | 长度 | 内容 |\n//! |---|---|---|\n//! | 0 | 8 | 魔数 `IMRKJRN1` |\n//! | 8 | 4 | payload 长度（小端 u32） |\n//! | 12 | n | payload（UTF-8 JSON，见 [`CommitRecord`]） |\n//! | 12+n | 32 | `SHA256(payload)` |\n//!\n//! 恢复时顺序解析帧：遇到第一个截断/校验失败的帧即停止，尾部丢弃（torn write）。\n//!\n//! # 同步边界（提交流程，每一步对应一个 [`FaultPoint`]）\n//!\n//! 1. 写暂存块 `tmp/staging/<i>` 并逐块 fsync（`ChunkWrite` / `ChunkSync`）。\n//! 2. 追加 journal 提交帧并 fsync journal（`JournalAppend` / `JournalSync`）——**提交点**：\n//!    此 fsync 返回后，即使断电，恢复也必须达到新状态。\n//! 3. 暂存块提升为 `chunks/<i>`，删除被收缩的尾块（`PromoteChunk`）。\n//! 4. 写 `manifest.json.tmp`、fsync、原子 rename 为 `manifest.json`\n//!    （`ManifestWrite` / `ManifestSync` / `ManifestRename`）——检查点。\n//! 5. 截断 journal 到 0 并 fsync（`JournalTruncate` / `JournalTruncateSync`），清理暂存块。\n//!\n//! 打开时重放：manifest 为基线，journal 中 version 更新的有效帧前滚（幂等：暂存块\n//! 缺失但正式块已存在即视为已提升），然后重写检查点并清空 journal。\n\nuse crate::merkle::{\n    self, build_levels, chunk_count, hash_leaf, prove_range, rebuild_root_from_chunks,\n    update_levels, Hash32, RangeProof, VerifyError, DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE,\n};\nuse crate::vfs::{FaultPoint, FaultPolicy, Vfs, VfsFile};\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\nuse sha2::{Digest, Sha256};\nuse std::io::{self, Read, SeekFrom, Write};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\npub const MANIFEST: &str = \"manifest.json\";\npub const MANIFEST_TMP: &str = \"manifest.json.tmp\";\npub const JOURNAL: &str = \"journal\";\npub const CHUNK_DIR: &str = \"chunks\";\npub const STAGE_DIR: &str = \"tmp/staging\";\n\nconst MAGIC: &[u8; 8] = b\"IMRKJRN1\";\n\n/// 存储库/格式错误。\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum StoreError {\n    Io(io::Error),\n    Corrupt(String),\n    Verify(VerifyError),\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for StoreError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            StoreError::Io(e) => write!(f, \"io error: {e}\"),\n            StoreError::Corrupt(m) => write!(f, \"corrupt repository: {m}\"),\n            StoreError::Verify(e) => write!(f, \"verification failed: {e}\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\nimpl std::error::Error for StoreError {}\nimpl From<io::Error> for StoreError {\n    fn from(e: io::Error) -> Self {\n        StoreError::Io(e)\n    }\n}\nimpl From<VerifyError> for StoreError {\n    fn from(e: VerifyError) -> Self {\n        StoreError::Verify(e)\n    }\n}\n\nfn corrupt(msg: impl Into<String>) -> StoreError {\n    StoreError::Corrupt(msg.into())\n}\n\n/// manifest 中持久化的已提交状态。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct ManifestState {\n    pub version: u64,\n    pub chunk_size: u64,\n    pub file_length: u64,\n    pub chunk_count: u64,\n    /// 派生根的 hex（自检用）。\n `tmp/staging/<i>` 并逐块 fsync（`ChunkWrite` / `ChunkSync`）。\n//! 2. 追加 journal 提交帧并 fsync journal（`JournalAppend` / `JournalSync`）——**提交点**：\n//!    此 fsync 返回后，即使断电，恢复也必须达到新状态。\n//! 3. 暂存块提升为 `chunks/<i>`，删除被收缩的尾块（`PromoteChunk`）。\n//! 4. 写 `manifest.json.tmp`、fsync、原子 rename 为 `manifest.json`\n//!    （`ManifestWrite` / `ManifestSync` / `ManifestRename`）——检查点。\n//! 5. 截断 journal 到 0 并 fsync（`JournalTruncate` / `JournalTruncateSync`），清理暂存块。\n//!\n//! 打开时重放：manifest 为基线，journal 中 version 更新的有效帧前滚（幂等：暂存块\n//! 缺失但正式块已存在即视为已提升），然后重写检查点并清空 journal。\n\nuse crate::merkle::{\n    self, build_levels, chunk_count, hash_leaf, prove_range, rebuild_root_from_chunks,\n    update_levels, Hash32, RangeProof, VerifyError, DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE,\n};\nuse crate::vfs::{FaultPoint, FaultPolicy, Vfs, VfsFile};\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\nuse sha2::{Digest, Sha256};\nuse std::io::{self, Read, SeekFrom, Write};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\npub const MANIFEST: &str = \"manifest.json\";\npub const MANIFEST_TMP: &str = \"manifest.json.tmp\";\npub const JOURNAL: &str = \"journal\";\npub const CHUNK_DIR: &str = \"chunks\";\npub const STAGE_DIR: &str = \"tmp/staging\";\n\nconst MAGIC: &[u8; 8] = b\"IMRKJRN1\";\n\n/// 存储库/格式错误。\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum StoreError {\n    Io(io::Error),\n    Corrupt(String),\n    Verify(VerifyError),\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for StoreError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            StoreError::Io(e) => write!(f, \"io error: {e}\"),\n            StoreError::Corrupt(m) => write!(f, \"corrupt repository: {m}\"),\n            StoreError::Verify(e) => write!(f, \"verification failed: {e}\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\nimpl std::error::Error for StoreError {}\nimpl From<io::Error> for StoreError {\n    fn from(e: io::Error) -> Self {\n        StoreError::Io(e)\n    }\n}\nimpl From<VerifyError> for StoreError {\n    fn from(e: VerifyError) -> Self {\n        StoreError::Verify(e)\n    }\n}\n\nfn corrupt(msg: impl Into<String>) -> StoreError {\n    StoreError::Corrupt(msg.into())\n}\n\n/// manifest 中持久化的已提交状态。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct ManifestState {\n    pub version: u64,\n    pub chunk_size: u64,\n    pub file_length: u64,\n    pub chunk_count: u64,\n    /// 派生根的 hex（自检用）。\n    pub root: String,\n}\n\n/// journal 中的一次提交记录。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]\nstruct CommitRecord {\n    version: u64,\n    chunk_size: u64,\n    file_length: u64,\n    chunk_count: u64,\n    /// 本次写入/覆盖的块序号（内容在 tmp/staging 或 chunks 中）。\n    changes: Vec<u64>,\n    /// 本次删除的尾块序号。\n    deletes: Vec<u64>,\n    root: String,\n}\n\n/// 文件支持的增量 Merkle 存储库。\npub struct Repository {\n    vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs>,\n    fault: Option<Arc<Mutex<FaultPolicy>>>,\n    on_crash: Option<Arc<dyn Fn() + Send + Sync>>,\n    chunk_size: u64,\n    file_length: u64,\n    version: u64,\n    /// `levels[0]` 为叶层；空文件时为空树（仅根由空根约定给出）。\n    levels: Vec<Vec<Hash32>>,\n}\n\nfn chunk_path(idx: u64) -> String {\n    format!(\"{CHUNK_DIR}/{idx}\")\n}\nfn staging_path(idx: u64) -> String {\n    format!(\"{STAGE_DIR}/{idx}\")\n}\n\n/// 打开/创建仓库的选项。\npub struct OpenOptions {\n    pub chunk_size: u64,\n    pub fault: Option<(Arc<Mutex<FaultPolicy>>, Arc<dyn Fn() + Send + Sync>)>,\n}\n\nimpl Default for OpenOptions {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Self {\n            chunk_size: DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE,\n            fault: None,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Repository {\n    /// 在给定 VFS 上打开（不存在则创建）仓库。\n    pub fn open(vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs>, chunk_size: u64) -> Result<Self, StoreError> {\n        Self::open_with(\n            vfs,\n            OpenOptions {\n                chunk_size,\n                fault: None,\n            },\n        )\n    }\n\n    /// 带故障注入打开（测试用）。`fault` 为共享策略，`on_crash` 为崩溃回调\n    /// （内存 VFS 上通常接 `MemVfs::simulate_crash`）。\n    pub fn open_with_faults(\n        vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs>,\n        chunk_size: u64,\n        fault: Arc<Mutex<FaultPolicy>>,\n        on_crash: Arc<dyn Fn() + Send + Sync>,\n    ) -> Result<Self, StoreError> {\n        Self::open_with(\n            vfs,\n            OpenOptions {\n                chunk_size,\n                fault: Some((fault, on_crash)),\n            },\n        )\n    }\n\n    fn open_with(vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs>, opts: OpenOptions) -> Result<Self, StoreError> {\n        if opts.chunk_size == 0 {\n            return Err(corrupt(\"chunk_size must be > 0\"));\n        }\n        vfs.mkdirs(CHUNK_DIR)?;\n        vfs.mkdirs(STAGE_DIR)?;\n\n        let mut repo = Repository {\n            vfs,\n            fault: opts.fault.as_ref().map(|(f, _)| f.clone()),\n            on_crash: opts.fault.as_ref().map(|(_, c)| c.clone()),\n            chunk_size: opts.chunk_size,\n            file_length: 0,\n            version: 0,\n            levels: Vec::new(),\n        };\n\n        if !repo.vfs.exists(MANIFEST) {\n            // 全新仓库：写入空状态检查点\n            repo.levels = Vec::new();\n            repo.write_manifest(0, 0, 0, merkle::root_from_leaves(&[], opts.chunk_size))?;\n            return Ok(repo);\n        }\n\n        // 1) 读 manifest 基线\n        let mut state = repo.read_manifest()?;\n        if state.chunk_size != opts.chunk_size {\n            return Err(corrupt(format!(\n                \"chunk_size mismatch: manifest={}, requested={}\",\n                state.chunk_size, opts.chunk_size\n            )));\n        }\n        repo.chunk_size = state.chunk_size;\n\n        // 2) 重放 journal\n        state = repo.replay_journal(state)?;\n\n        // 3) 载入状态并从磁盘块重建树（打开时全量一次；之后验证只按范围读块）\n        repo.version = state.version;\n        repo.file_length = state.file_length;\n        repo.levels = repo.load_levels(state.chunk_count)?;\n\n        let root = repo.root();\n        if root != decode_hex32(&state.root).ok_or_else(|| corrupt(\"bad root hex in manifest\"))? {\n            return Err(corrupt(\n                \"manifest root does not match blocks rebuilt from chunks/\",\n            ));\n        }\n        Ok(repo)\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 基本访问器 ----------\n\n    pub fn chunk_size(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.chunk_size\n    }\n    pub fn file_length(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.file_length\n    }\n    pub fn chunk_count(&self) -> u64 {\n        if self.levels.is_empty() {\n            0\n        } else {\n            self.levels[0].len() as u64\n        }\n    }\n    pub fn version(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.version\n    }\n    pub fn root(&self) -> Hash32 {\n        if self.levels.is_empty() {\n            merkle::hash_empty_root_pub(self.chunk_size)\n        } else {\n            self.levels.last().unwrap()[0]\n        }\n    }\n    pub fn root_hex(&self) -> String {\n        crate::hex_codec::to_hex(&self.root())\n    }\n\n    /// 读取单个块（仅用于生成范围证明，不需要全文件）。\n    pub fn read_chunk(&self, idx: u64) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        let mut f = self.vfs.open(&chunk_path(idx))?;\n        let mut buf = Vec::new();\n        f.read_to_end(&mut buf)?;\n        Ok(buf)\n    }\n\n    /// 生成 `[start, end)` 块区间的范围证明，只读取区间内块。\n    pub fn range_proof(&self, start: u64, end: u64) -> Result<RangeProof, StoreError> {\n        let total = self.chunk_count();\n        let proof = prove_range(\n            &self.levels,\n            self.chunk_size,\n            self.file_length,\n            total,\n            start,\n            end,\n            |i| self.read_chunk(i).ok(),\n            self.root(),\n        )?;\n        Ok(proof)\n    }\n\n    /// 磁盘完整性自检：重新读取 chunks/ 全量重建根并与当前根比较（验收基线）。\n    pub fn verify_block_store(&self) -> Result<Hash32, StoreError> {\n        let n = self.chunk_count();\n        let mut chunks = Vec::with_capacity(n as usize);\n        for i in 0..n {\n            chunks.push(self.read_chunk(i)?);\n        }\n        let rebuilt = rebuild_root_from_chunks(&chunks, self.chunk_size);\n        if rebuilt != self.root() {\n            return Err(corrupt(\"rebuilt root differs from committed root\"));\n        }\n        if chunk_count(self.file_length, self.chunk_size) != n {\n            return Err(corrupt(\"file_length/chunk_size inconsistent with chunk_count\"));\n        }\n        Ok(rebuilt)\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 写入：整文件替换（内部走增量路径） ----------\n\n    /// 用新文件内容替换当前文件。\n    ///\n    /// 仅内容不同的块参与提交；长度不变时 Merkle 各层走增量重算\n    /// （[`update_levels`]，只重算脏路径）；块数变化（增长/缩短）时整树重建。\n    /// 返回写入的块数与删除的块数。\n    pub fn put_file(&mut self, data: &[u8]) -> Result<(usize, usize), StoreError> {\n        let cs = self.chunk_size;\n        let new_count = chunk_count(data.len() as u64, cs);\n        let old_count = self.chunk_count();\n\n        // 找出内容变化的块\n        let mut changes: Vec<(u64, Vec<u8>)> = Vec::new();\n        for i in 0..new_count {\n            let start = (i * cs) as usize;\n            let end = ((i + 1) * cs as usize).min(data.len());\n            let new_bytes = data[start..end].to_vec();\n            let same = if i < old_count {\n                self.read_chunk(i).map(|old| old == new_bytes).unwrap_or(false)\n            } else {\n                false\n            };\n            if !same {\n                changes.push((i, new_bytes));\n            }\n        }\n        let deletes: Vec<u64> = (new_count..old_count).collect();\n\n        if changes.is_empty() && deletes.is_empty() {\n            return Ok((0, 0)); // 内容完全相同\n        }\n\n        let new_root = self.commit(&changes, &deletes, data.len() as u64, new_count)?;\n\n        // 更新内存中的树\n        if new_count == old_count {\n            let leaf_changes: Vec<(u64, Hash32)> = changes\n                .iter()\n                .map(|(i, bytes)| (*i, hash_leaf(*i, cs, bytes)))\n                .collect();\n            self.levels = update_levels(&self.levels, &leaf_changes);\n        } else {\n            // 树形变了，全量重建（块数变化）\n            self.levels = self.load_levels(new_count)?;\n        }\n        debug_assert_eq!(self.levels.last().map(|l| l[0]).unwrap_or(new_root), new_root);\n        self.file_length = data.len() as u64;\n\n        Ok((changes.len(), deletes.len()))\n    }\n\n    // ---------- WAL 提交流程 ----------\n\n    fn fault(&self, at: FaultPoint) -> io::Result<()> {\n        if let Some(p) = &self.fault {\n            let crash = self.on_crash.clone();\n            p.lock()\n                .unwrap()\n                .hit(at, &|| {\n                    if let Some(c) = &crash {\n                        c();\n                    }\n                })\n        } else {\n            Ok(())\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 执行一次事务，返回新根。\n    fn commit(\n        &mut self,\n        changes: &[(u64, Vec<u8>)],\n        deletes: &[u64],\n        new_length: u64,\n        new_count: u64,\n    ) -> Result<Hash32, StoreError> {\n        let new_version = self.version + 1;\n\n        // 预估新根（暂存块写完后即可计算；根也写入提交帧）\n        let new_root = self.preview_root(changes, new_count)?;\n\n        // 1) 暂存块落盘并 fsync\n        for (idx, bytes) in changes {\n            self.fault(FaultPoint::ChunkWrite)\n                .map_err(StoreError::Io)?;\n            let mut f = self.vfs.create(&staging_path(*idx))?;\n            f.write_all(bytes)?;\n            f.flush()?;\n            self.fault(FaultPoint::ChunkSync).map_err(StoreError::Io)?;\n            f.sync_all()?;\n            drop(f);\n        }\n\n        // 2) journal 追加提交帧并 fsync —— 提交点\n        let record = CommitRecord {\n            version: new_version,\n            chunk_size: self.chunk_size,\n            file_length: new_length,\n            chunk_count: new_count,\n            changes: changes.iter().map(|(i, _)| *i).collect(),\n            deletes: deletes.to_vec(),\n            root: crate::hex_codec::to_hex(&new_root),\n        };\n        let frame = encode_frame(&record);\n        self.fault(FaultPoint::JournalAppend)\n            .map_err(StoreError::Io)?;\n        {\n            let mut j = self.vfs.open(JOURNAL).or_else(|_| self.vfs.create(JOURNAL))?;\n            j.seek(SeekFrom::End(0))?;\n            j.write_all(&frame)?;\n            j.flush()?;\n            self.fault(FaultPoint::JournalSync).map_err(StoreError::Io)?;\n            j.sync_all()?;\n        }\n\n        // 3) 提升暂存块、删除尾块\n        for (idx, _) in changes {\n            self.fault(FaultPoint::PromoteChunk)\n                .map_err(StoreError::Io)?;\n            // rename 在真实 FS 与 MemVfs 上均覆盖已存在目标\n            self.vfs.rename(&staging_path(*idx), &chunk_path(*idx))?;\n        }\n        for idx in deletes {\n            if self.vfs.exists(&chunk_path(*idx)) {\n                self.vfs.remove(&chunk_path(*idx))?;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 4) manifest 检查点（tmp + fsync + rename）\n        self.fault(FaultPoint::ManifestWrite)\n            .map_err(StoreError::Io)?;\n        {\n            let mut m = self.vfs.create(MANIFEST_TMP)?;\n            m.write_all(serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&ManifestState {\n                version: new_version,\n                chunk_size: self.chunk_size,\n                file_length: new_length,\n                chunk_count: new_count,\n                root: crate::hex_codec::to_hex(&new_root),\n            })?)?;\n            m.flush()?;\n            self.fault(FaultPoint::ManifestSync)\n                .map_err(StoreError::Io)?;\n            m.sync_all()?;\n        }\n        self.fault(FaultPoint::ManifestRename)\n            .map_err(StoreError::Io)?;\n        self.vfs.rename(MANIFEST_TMP, MANIFEST)?;\n\n        // 5) journal 截断并 fsync，随后清理暂存残留\n        self.fault(FaultPoint::JournalTruncate)\n            .map_err(StoreError::Io)?;\n        {\n            let mut j = self.vfs.open(JOURNAL)?;\n            j.set_len(0)?;\n            j.seek(SeekFrom::Start(0))?;\n            self.fault(FaultPoint::JournalTruncateSync)\n                .map_err(StoreError::Io)?;\n            j.sync_all()?;\n        }\n        for (idx, _) in changes {\n            let sp = staging_path(*idx);\n            if self.vfs.exists(&sp) {\n                let _ = self.vfs.remove(&sp);\n            }\n        }\n\n        self.version = new_version;\n        Ok(new_root)\n    }\n\n    /// 不落盘地预览提交后的根（同形树走增量，变形树重建）。\n    fn preview_root(\n        &self,\n        changes: &[(u64, Vec<u8>)],\n        new_count: u64,\n    ) -> Result<Hash32, StoreError> {\n        let old_count = self.chunk_count();\n        if new_count == old_count {\n            if self.levels.is_empty() && new_count == 0 {\n                return Ok(merkle::hash_empty_root_pub(self.chunk_size));\n            }\n            let leaf_changes: Vec<(u64, Hash32)> = changes\n                .iter()\n                .map(|(i, bytes)| (*i, hash_leaf(*i, self.chunk_size, bytes)))\n                .collect();\n            let updated = update_levels(&self.levels, &leaf_changes);\n            Ok(updated.last().unwrap()[0])\n        } else {\n            // 变形：按“新块集合”全量计算\n            let mut leaves: Vec<Hash32> = Vec::with_capacity(new_count as usize);\n            for i in 0..new_count {\n                let h = if let Some((_, bytes)) = changes.iter().find(|(idx, _)| *idx == i) {\n                    hash_leaf(i, self.chunk_size, bytes)\n                } else if i < old_count {\n                    let bytes = self.read_chunk(i)?;\n                    hash_leaf(i, self.chunk_size, &bytes)\n                } else {\n                    return Err(corrupt(format!(\"new chunk {i} missing in preview\")));\n                };\n                leaves.push(h);\n            }\n            Ok(merkle::root_from_leaves(&leaves, self.chunk_size))\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- manifest / journal ----------\n\n    fn write_manifest(\n        &mut self,\n        version: u64,\n        file_length: u64,\n        count: u64,\n        root: Hash32,\n    ) -> Result<(), StoreError> {\n        let state = ManifestState {\n            version,\n            chunk_size: self.chunk_size,\n            file_length,\n            chunk_count: count,\n            root: crate::hex_codec::to_hex(&root),\n        };\n        let mut m = self.vfs.create(MANIFEST)?;\n        m.write_all(serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&state)?)?;\n        m.sync_all()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn read_manifest(&self) -> Result<ManifestState, StoreError> {\n        let mut f = self.vfs.open(MANIFEST)?;\n        let mut buf = Vec::new();\n        f.read_to_end(&mut buf)?;\n        serde_json::from_slice(&buf).map_err(|e| corrupt(format!(\"bad manifest.json: {e}\")))\n    }\n\n    /// 顺序重放 journal 中的有效帧，返回最终状态；重放结束后写检查点并清空 journal。\n    fn replay_journal(&self, base: ManifestState) -> Result<ManifestState, StoreError> {\n        let raw = if self.vfs.exists(JOURNAL) {\n            let mut f = self.vfs.open(JOURNAL)?;\n            let mut buf = Vec::new();\n            f.read_to_end(&mut buf)?;\n            buf\n        } else {\n            Vec::new()\n        };\n\n        let mut state = base;\n        let mut pos = 0usize;\n        let mut applied_any = false;\n        loop {\n            match parse_frame(&raw[pos..]) {\n                FrameResult::Frame { record, len } => {\n                    if record.chunk_size != state.chunk_size {\n                        return Err(corrupt(\"journal chunk_size differs from manifest\"));\n                    }\n                    if record.version > state.version {\n                        self.apply_record(&record)?;\n                        state = ManifestState {\n                            version: record.version,\n                            chunk_size: record.chunk_size,\n                            file_length: record.file_length,\n                            chunk_count: record.chunk_count,\n                            root: record.root.clone(),\n                        };\n                        applied_any = true;\n                    }\n                    pos += len;\n                }\n                FrameResult::Empty => break,\n                // 截断/损坏尾部：丢弃剩余字节（本次重放不会让它们生效）\n                FrameResult::Torn => break,\n            }\n        }\n\n        if applied_any || !raw.is_empty() {\n            // 恢复检查点（幂等）\n            let root = decode_hex32(&state.root)\n                .ok_or_else(|| corrupt(\"bad root hex in journal record\"))?;\n            let mut m = self.vfs.create(MANIFEST_TMP)?;\n            m.write_all(serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&state)?)?;\n            m.sync_all()?;\n            drop(m);\n            self.vfs.rename(MANIFEST_TMP, MANIFEST)?;\n\n            if self.vfs.exists(JOURNAL) {\n                let mut j = self.vfs.open(JOURNAL)?;\n                j.set_len(0)?;\n                j.sync_all()?;\n            }\n            // 重放后再次自检：磁盘块必须与记录的根一致\n            let n = state.chunk_count;\n            let mut chunks = Vec::with_capacity(n as usize);\n            for i in 0..n {\n                let mut f = self.vfs.open(&chunk_path(i))?;\n                let mut buf = Vec::new();\n                f.read_to_end(&mut buf)?;\n                chunks.push(buf);\n            }\n            let rebuilt = rebuild_root_from_chunks(&chunks, state.chunk_size);\n            if rebuilt != root {\n                return Err(corrupt(\"post-replay root mismatch\"));\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(state)\n    }\n\n    /// 幂等应用一帧：暂存块提升（若存在），删除尾块。\n    fn apply_record(&self, record: &CommitRecord) -> Result<(), StoreError> {\n        for idx in &record.changes {\n            let sp = staging_path(*idx);\n            let cp = chunk_path(*idx);\n            if self.vfs.exists(&sp) {\n                self.vfs.rename(&sp, &cp)?;\n            } else if !self.vfs.exists(&cp) {\n                return Err(corrupt(format!(\n                    \"journal v{} references missing chunk {idx}\",\n                    record.version\n                )));\n            }\n        }\n        for idx in &record.deletes {\n            let cp = chunk_path(*idx);\n            if self.vfs.exists(&cp) {\n                self.vfs.remove(&cp)?;\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn load_levels(&self, count: u64) -> Result<Vec<Vec<Hash32>>, StoreError> {\n        if count == 0 {\n            return Ok(Vec::new());\n        }\n        let mut leaves = Vec::with_capacity(count as usize);\n        for i in 0..count {\n            let bytes = self.read_chunk(i)?;\n            leaves.push(hash_leaf(i, self.chunk_size, &bytes));\n        }\n        Ok(build_levels(&leaves))\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------- 帧编解码 ----------------\n\nfn encode_frame(record: &CommitRecord) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let payload = serde_json::to_vec(record).expect(\"record serialization\");\n    let checksum: [u8; 32] = Sha256::digest(&payload).into();\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(12 + payload.len() + 32);\n    out.extend_from_slice(MAGIC);\n    out.extend_from_slice(&(payload.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());\n    out.extend_from_slice(&payload);\n    out.extend_from_slice(&checksum);\n    out\n}\n\nenum FrameResult<'a> {\n    Frame { record: CommitRecord, len: usize },\n    Empty,\n    Torn,\n}\n\nfn parse_frame(buf: &[u8]) -> FrameResult<'_> {\n    if buf.is_empty() {\n        return FrameResult::Empty;\n    }\n    if buf.len() < 12 + 32 || &buf[..8] != MAGIC {\n        return FrameResult::Torn;\n    }\n    let payload_len = u32::from_le_bytes(buf[8..12].try_into().unwrap()) as usize;\n    if payload_len == 0 || 12 + payload_len + 32 > buf.len() {\n        return FrameResult::Torn;\n    }\n    let payload = &buf[12..12 + {"parentUuid":"f63029b1-9f13-42db-80eb-a29fea0f5876","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_nkn0uu3gotmp754doqff8n52","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp10/b/src/http.rs","content":"//! 本地 HTTP 验证入口（纯 `std::net`，无第三方运行时，线程/连接）。\n//!\n//! # 路由\n//!\n//! | 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |\n//! |---|---|---|\n//! | POST | `/repos/:name/open?chunk_size=4096` | 创建/打开仓库（幂等） |\n//! | PUT  | `/repos/:name/file` | 写入/替换文件，body 为 hex 字符串 |\n//! | GET  | `/repos/:name` | 查询状态（根、长度、块数、版本） |\n//! | GET  | `/repos/:name/proof?start=&end=` | 生成范围证明（默认全范围） |\n//! | POST | `/verify` | 独立校验请求体中的 [`RangeProof`]（不依赖任何仓库/文件） |\n//!\n//! 错误统一为 `{\"error\":\"...\"}` + 非 2xx 状态码。\n\nuse crate::merkle::RangeProof;\nuse crate::store::Repository;\nuse crate::vfs::{MemVfs, RealVfs, Vfs};\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\ntype SharedRepo = Arc<Mutex<Repository>>;\n\n/// 服务端注册表。\npub struct Server {\n    data_dir: PathBuf,\n    repos: Mutex<HashMap<String, SharedRepo>>,\n}\n\nimpl Server {\n    pub fn new(data_dir: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> Arc<Self> {\n        Arc::new(Self {\n            data_dir: data_dir.into(),\n            repos: Mutex::new(HashMap::new()),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// 阻塞监听。\n    pub fn serve(self: &Arc<Self>, addr: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(&self.data_dir)?;\n        let listener = TcpListener::bind(addr)?;\n        eprintln!(\"imerkle listening on http://{addr} (data dir: {:?})\", self.data_dir);\n        for stream in listener.incoming() {\n            match stream {\n                Ok(s) => {\n                    let server = self.clone();\n                    std::thread::spawn(move || {\n                        let _ = handle_connection(server, s);\n                    });\n                }\n                Err(e) => eprintln!(\"accept error: {e}\"),\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn get_repo(&self, name: &str) -> Option<SharedRepo> {\n        self.repos.lock().unwrap().get(name).cloned()\n    }\n\n    fn open_repo(&self, name: &str, chunk_size: u64) -> Result<SharedRepo, String> {\n        validate_name(name)?;\n        let mut repos = self.repos.lock().unwrap();\n        if let Some(r) = repos.get(name) {\n            return Ok(r.clone());\n        }\n        let dir = self.data_dir.join(name);\n        let vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs> = Arc::new(RealVfs::new(&dir));\n        let repo = Repository::open(vfs, chunk_size).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n        let arc = Arc::new(Mutex::new(repo));\n        repos.insert(name.to_string(), arc.clone());\n        Ok(arc)\n    }\n}\n\nfn validate_name(name: &str) -> Result<(), String> {\n    if name.is_empty()\n        || name.len() > 64\n        || !name\n            .chars()\n            .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '-' || c == '_')\n    {\n        return Err(\"invalid repo name (allowed: A-Z a-z 0-9 - _)\".into());\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nstruct Request {\n    method: String,\n    path: String,\n    query: String,\n    body: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\nfn read_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<Request> {\n    let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(8192);\n    let mut tmp = [0u8; 4096];\n    // 读到 header 结束\n    let header_end = loop {\n        let n = stream.read(&mut tmp)?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            return Err(std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof, \"empty\"));\n        }\n        buf.extend_from_slice(&tmp[..n]);\n        if let Some(p) = find_subsequence(&buf, b\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\") {\n            break p;\n        }\n        if buf.len() > 64 * 1024 * 1024 {\n            return Err(std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, \"header too large\"));\n        }\n    };\n\n    let header = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..header_end]).to_string();\n    let mut lines = header.split(\"\\r\\n\");\n    let request_line = lines.next().unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let mut parts = request_line.split_whitespace();\n    let method = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"\").to_string();\n    let raw_target = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let (path, query) = match raw_target.split_once('?') {\n        Some((p, q)) => (p.to_string(), q.to_string()),\n        None => (raw_target.to_string(), String::new()),\n    };\n\n    let content_length: usize = lines\n        .find_map(|l| {\n            let (k, v) = l.split_once(':')?;\n            if k.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"content-length\") {\n                v.trim().parse().ok()\n            } else {\n                None\n            }\n        })\n        .unwrap_or(0);\n\n    let mut body = buf[header_end + 4..].to_vec();\n    while body.len() < content_length {\n        let n = stream.read(&mut tmp)?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            break;\n        }\n `/repos/:name/file` | 写入/替换文件，body 为 hex 字符串 |\n//! | GET  | `/repos/:name` | 查询状态（根、长度、块数、版本） |\n//! | GET  | `/repos/:name/proof?start=&end=` | 生成范围证明（默认全范围） |\n//! | POST | `/verify` | 独立校验请求体中的 [`RangeProof`]（不依赖任何仓库/文件） |\n//!\n//! 错误统一为 `{\"error\":\"...\"}` + 非 2xx 状态码。\n\nuse crate::merkle::RangeProof;\nuse crate::store::Repository;\nuse crate::vfs::{MemVfs, RealVfs, Vfs};\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\ntype SharedRepo = Arc<Mutex<Repository>>;\n\n/// 服务端注册表。\npub struct Server {\n    data_dir: PathBuf,\n    repos: Mutex<HashMap<String, SharedRepo>>,\n}\n\nimpl Server {\n    pub fn new(data_dir: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> Arc<Self> {\n        Arc::new(Self {\n            data_dir: data_dir.into(),\n            repos: Mutex::new(HashMap::new()),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// 阻塞监听。\n    pub fn serve(self: &Arc<Self>, addr: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(&self.data_dir)?;\n        let listener = TcpListener::bind(addr)?;\n        eprintln!(\"imerkle listening on http://{addr} (data dir: {:?})\", self.data_dir);\n        for stream in listener.incoming() {\n            match stream {\n                Ok(s) => {\n                    let server = self.clone();\n                    std::thread::spawn(move || {\n                        let _ = handle_connection(server, s);\n                    });\n                }\n                Err(e) => eprintln!(\"accept error: {e}\"),\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn get_repo(&self, name: &str) -> Option<SharedRepo> {\n        self.repos.lock().unwrap().get(name).cloned()\n    }\n\n    fn open_repo(&self, name: &str, chunk_size: u64) -> Result<SharedRepo, String> {\n        validate_name(name)?;\n        let mut repos = self.repos.lock().unwrap();\n        if let Some(r) = repos.get(name) {\n            return Ok(r.clone());\n        }\n        let dir = self.data_dir.join(name);\n        let vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs> = Arc::new(RealVfs::new(&dir));\n        let repo = Repository::open(vfs, chunk_size).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n        let arc = Arc::new(Mutex::new(repo));\n        repos.insert(name.to_string(), arc.clone());\n        Ok(arc)\n    }\n}\n\nfn validate_name(name: &str) -> Result<(), String> {\n    if name.is_empty()\n        || name.len() > 64\n        || !name\n            .chars()\n            .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '-' || c == '_')\n    {\n        return Err(\"invalid repo name (allowed: A-Z a-z 0-9 - _)\".into());\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nstruct Request {\n    method: String,\n    path: String,\n    query: String,\n    body: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\nfn read_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<Request> {\n    let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(8192);\n    let mut tmp = [0u8; 4096];\n    // 读到 header 结束\n    let header_end = loop {\n        let n = stream.read(&mut tmp)?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            return Err(std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof, \"empty\"));\n        }\n        buf.extend_from_slice(&tmp[..n]);\n        if let Some(p) = find_subsequence(&buf, b\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\") {\n            break p;\n        }\n        if buf.len() > 64 * 1024 * 1024 {\n            return Err(std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, \"header too large\"));\n        }\n    };\n\n    let header = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..header_end]).to_string();\n    let mut lines = header.split(\"\\r\\n\");\n    let request_line = lines.next().unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let mut parts = request_line.split_whitespace();\n    let method = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"\").to_string();\n    let raw_target = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let (path, query) = match raw_target.split_once('?') {\n        Some((p, q)) => (p.to_string(), q.to_string()),\n        None => (raw_target.to_string(), String::new()),\n    };\n\n    let content_length: usize = lines\n        .find_map(|l| {\n            let (k, v) = l.split_once(':')?;\n            if k.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"content-length\") {\n                v.trim().parse().ok()\n            } else {\n                None\n            }\n        })\n        .unwrap_or(0);\n\n    let mut body = buf[header_end + 4..].to_vec();\n    while body.len() < content_length {\n        let n = stream.read(&mut tmp)?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            break;\n        }\n        body.extend_from_slice(&tmp[..n]);\n    }\n    body.truncate(content_length);\n\n    Ok(Request {\n        method,\n        path,\n        query,\n        body,\n    })\n}\n\nfn find_subsequence(haystack: &[u8], needle: &[u8]) -> Option<usize> {\n    haystack\n        .windows(needle.len())\n        .position(|w| w == needle)\n}\n\nfn query_params(q: &str) -> HashMap<String, String> {\n    let mut out = HashMap::new();\n    for pair in q.split('&').filter(|s| !s.is_empty()) {\n        if let Some((k, v)) = pair.split_once('=') {\n            out.insert(url_decode(k), url_decode(v));\n        }\n    }\n    out\n}\n\nfn url_decode(s: &str) -> String {\n    let bytes = s.as_bytes();\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(bytes.len());\n    let mut i = 0;\n    while i < bytes.len() {\n        match bytes[i] {\n            b'%' if i + 2 < bytes.len() => {\n                let hi = hex_val(bytes[i + 1]);\n                let lo = hex_val(bytes[i + 2]);\n                if let (Some(h), Some(l)) = (hi, lo) {\n                    out.push((h << 4) | l);\n                    i += 3;\n                    continue;\n                }\n                out.push(bytes[i]);\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            b'+' => {\n                out.push(b' ');\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            b => {\n                out.push(b);\n                i += 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    String::from_utf8_lossy(&out).into_owned()\n}\n\nfn hex_val(c: u8) -> Option<u8> {\n    match c {\n        b'0'..=b'9' => Some(c - b'0'),\n        b'a'..=b'f' => Some(c - b'a' + 10),\n        b'A'..=b'F' => Some(c - b'A' + 10),\n        _ => None,\n    }\n}\n\nfn handle_connection(server: Arc<Server>, mut stream: TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let req = match read_request(&mut stream) {\n        Ok(r) => r,\n        Err(_) => return Ok(()),\n    };\n    let resp = route(&server, &req);\n    write_response(&mut stream, resp.0, &resp.1, resp.2.as_deref())\n}\n\nfn route(server: &Server, req: &Request) -> (u16, Vec<u8>, Option<&'static str>) {\n    let json = Some(\"application/json\");\n serde_json::from_slice::<RangeProof>(&req.body) {\n            Ok(proof) => match proof.verify() {\n                Ok(()) => (\n                    200,\n                    serde_json::json!({\"valid\": true}).to_string().into_bytes(),\n                    json,\n                ),\n                Err(e) => (\n                    200,\n                    serde_json::json!({\"valid\": false, \"error\": e.to_string()})\n                        .to_string()\n                        .into_bytes(),\n                    json,\n                ),\n            },\n            Err(e) => (\n                400,\n                serde_json::json!({\"error\": format!(\"malformed proof JSON: {e}\")})\n                    .to_string()\n                    .into_bytes(),\n                json,\n            ),\n        };\n    }\n\n    // /repos/:name/...\n    if segments.first() == Some(&\"repos\") {\n        let name = segments.get(1).copied().unwrap_or(\"\");\n        if name.is_empty() {\n            return err(404, \"not found\");\n        }\n        let sub = segments.get(2..).unwrap_or(&[]);\n\n        // POST /repos/:name/open?chunk_size=\n        if req.method == \"POST\" && sub == [\"open\"] {\n            let params = query_params(&req.query);\n            let chunk_size = params\n                .get(\"chunk_size\")\n                .map(|v| v.parse::<u64>())\n                .transpose();\n            let chunk_size = match chunk_size {\n                Ok(Some(n)) if n > 0 => n,\n                Ok(None) => crate::merkle::DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE,\n                _ => return err(400, \"chunk_size must be a positive integer\"),\n            };\n            return match server.open_repo(name, chunk_size) {\n                Ok(repo) => {\n                    let r = repo.lock().unwrap();\n                    (\n                        200,\n                        serde_json::json!({\n                            \"repo\": name,\n                            \"chunk_size\": r.chunk_size(),\n                            \"file_length\": r.file_length(),\n                            \"chunk_count\": r.chunk_count(),\n                            \"version\": r.version(),\n                            \"root\": r.root_hex(),\n                        })\n                        .to_string()\n                        .into_bytes(),\n                        json,\n                    )\n                }\n                Err(e) => err(500, &e),\n            };\n        }\n\n        // 以下路由需要已打开的仓库\n        let repo = match server.get_repo(name) {\n            Some(r) => r,\n            None => return err(404, &format!(\"repo '{name}' is not open; POST /repos/{name}/open\")),\n        };\n\n        // GET /repos/:name\n        if req.method == \"GET\" && sub.is_empty() {\n            let r = repo.lock().unwrap();\n            return (\n                200,\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"repo\": name,\n                    \"chunk_size\": r.chunk_size(),\n                    \"file_length\": r.file_length(),\n                    \"chunk_count\": r.chunk_count(),\n                    \"version\": r.version(),\n                    \"root\": r.root_hex(),\n                })\n                .to_string()\n                .into_bytes(),\n                json,\n            );\n        }\n\n        // PUT /repos/:name/file  body: JSON {\"data\":\"<hex>\"} 或裸 hex 字符串\n        if req.method == \"PUT\" && sub == [\"file\"] {\n            let data_hex: String = if let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_slice::<serde_json::Value>(&req.body)\n            {\n                v.get(\"data\")\n                    .and_then(|x| x.as_str())\n                    .unwrap_or(\"\")\n                    .to_string()\n            } else {\n                String::from_utf8_lossy(&req.body).trim().to_string()\n            };\n            let data = match crate::hex_codec::from_hex(data_hex.trim()) {\n                Some(d) => d,\n                None => return err(400, \"body must be hex string or {\\\"data\\\":\\\"<hex>\\\"}\"),\n            };\n            let mut r = repo.lock().unwrap();\n            return match r.put_file(&data) {\n                Ok((written, deleted)) => (\n                    200,\n                    serde_json::json!({\n                        \"file_length\": r.file_length(),\n                        \"chunk_count\": r.chunk_count(),\n                        \"version\": r.version(),\n                        \"root\": r.root_hex(),\n                        \"chunks_written\": written,\n                        \"chunks_deleted\": deleted,\n                    })\n                    .to_string()\n                    .into_bytes(),\n                    json,\n                ),\n                Err(e) => err(500, &format!(\"commit failed: {e}\")),\n            };\n        }\n\n        // GET /repos/:name/proof?start=&end=\n        if req.method == \"GET\" && sub == [\"proof\"] {\n            let params = query_params(&req.query);\n            let r = repo.lock().unwrap();\n            let total = r.chunk_count();\n            let start = match params.get(\"start\").map(|v| v.parse::<u64>()).transpose() {\n                Ok(Some(n)) => n,\n                Ok(None) => 0,\n                Err(_) => return err(400, \"start must be an integer\"),\n            };\n            let end = match params.get(\"end\").map(|v| v.parse::<u64>()).transpose() {\n                Ok(Some(n)) => n,\n                Ok(None) => total,\n                Err(_) => return err(400, \"end must be an integer\"),\n            };\n            if total == 0 {\n     let mem = MemVfs::new();\n            let fs: Arc<dyn Vfs> = Arc::new(mem.clone());\n            let policy = Arc::new(Mutex::new(FaultPolicy::new().crash(point, 1)));\n            let on_crash: drop(repo);\n\n            let reopened = Repository::open(fs.clone(), 16)\n                .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!(\"reopen failed after crash at {point:?}: {e}\"));\n            reopened\n committed_before_commit_point = matches!(\n                point,\n                FaultPoint::ChunkWrite\n                    | FaultPoint::ChunkSync\n                    | FaultPoint::JournalAppend\n                    | FaultPoint::JournalSync\n            );\n            // JournalSync 命中故障意味着 fsync“未成功返回”：按严格语义视为未提交\n            if committed_before_commit_point {\n 1) as usize].len();\n        for &(idx, h) in &dirty {\n            levels[(level_no - 1) as usize][idx as usize] = h;\n        }\n        let mut next_dirty = Vec::with_capacity(dirty.len());\n        for (idx, _) in dirty.drain(..) {\n            let parent = idx / 2;\n            if idx % 2 == 1 {\n                // 脏节点是右孩子，且它是该层最后一个（奇数提升），直接把新值提升\n                if idx as usize == width - {"parentUuid":"d137973b-1368-45ac-b5d4-e3b16534f402","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"edited_text_file","filename":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp10/b/src/merkle.rs","snippet":"1\t//! Merkle 树：分块、域分离哈希、奇数提升、范围证明与验证。\n2\t//!\n3\t//! # 哈希规范（所有参与方必须一致）\n4\t//!\n5\t//! - 底层哈希：SHA-256，输出 32 字节。\n6\t//! - **空文件**（0 个块）的根固定为 `SHA-256(\"MERKLE_EMPTY_ROOT_v1\" || u64-le(chunk_size))`。\n7\t//! - **叶节点**（对应一个数据块）：`SHA-256(0x00 || u64-le(chunk_index) || u64-le(chunk_size) || chunk_bytes)`。\n8\t//!   块序号绑定进叶摘要，防止块在证明中被重排。\n9\t//! - **内部节点**：\n10\t//!   - 普通双亲：`SHA-256(0x01 || u64-le(level) || left_hash || right_hash)`，level 从 1 开始（level0 为叶层）。\n11\t//!   - **奇数提升**：某层节点数为奇数时，最后一个节点不复制、不哈希，原样提升到上一层同位置。\n12\t//! - 块大小是协议参数（默认 4096），参与叶/空根哈希，防止跨参数混用。\n13\t//!\n14\t//! 域前缀（0x00 / 0x01）使叶与内部节点不可能互相伪造；level 绑定使同值在不同层产生不同摘要。\n15\t\n16\tuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\n17\tuse sha2::{Digest, Sha256};\n18\t\n19\tuse crate::hex_codec;\n20\t\n21\t/// 默认块大小（字节）。\n22\tpub const DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE: u64 = 4096;\n23\t\n24\t/// SHA-256 摘要。\n25\tpub type Hash32 = [u8; 32];\n26\t\n27\t/// 计算文件需要的块数。空文件为 0，否则 `ceil(len / chunk_size)`。\n28\tpub fn chunk_count(file_len: u64, chunk_size: u64) -> u64 {\n29\t    assert!(chunk_size > 0, \"chunk_size must be > 0\");\n30\t    file_len.div_ceil(chunk_size)\n31\t}\n32\t\n33\t/// 块 `index` 在文件中的字节偏移。\n34\tpub fn chunk_offset(index: u64, chunk_size: u64) -> u64 {\n35\t    index.checked_mul(chunk_size).expect(\"offset overflow\")\n36\t}\n37\t\n38\tfn hash_empty_root(chunk_size: u64) -> Hash32 {\n39\t    let mut h = Sha256::new();\n40\t    h.update(b\"MERKLE_EMPTY_ROOT_v1\");\n41\t    h.update(chunk_size.to_le_bytes());\n42\t    h.finalize().into()\n43\t}\n44\t\n45\t/// 空文件（0 个块）的协议根：`SHA-256(\"MERKLE_EMPTY_ROOT_v1\" || u64-le(chunk_size))`。\n46\tpub fn hash_empty_root_pub(chunk_size: u64) -> Hash32 {\n47\t    hash_empty_root(chunk_size)\n48\t}\n49\t\n50\t/// 计算叶节点摘要：`SHA-256(0x00 || u64-le(index) || u64-le(chunk_size) || bytes)`。\n51\tpub fn hash_leaf(index: u64, chunk_size: u64, bytes: &[u8]) -> Hash32 {\n52\t    let mut h = Sha256::new();\n53\t    h.update([0x00u8]);\n54\t    h.update(index.to_le_bytes());\n55\t    h.update(chunk_size.to_le_bytes());\n56\t    h.update(bytes);\n57\t    h.finalize().into()\n58\t}\n59\t\n60\t/// 计算内部双亲摘要：`SHA-256(0x01 || u64-le(level) || left || right)`。\n61\tpub fn hash_pair(level: u64, left: &Hash32, right: &Hash32) -> Hash32 {\n62\t    let mut h = Sha256::new();\n63\t    h.update([0x01u8]);\n64\t    h.update(level.to_le_bytes());\n65\t    h.update(left);\n66\t    h.update(right);\n67\t    h.finalize().into()\n68\t}\n69\t\n70\t/// 一层节点的奇偶归约：两两哈希，奇数个时末尾节点原样提升。\n71\t///\n72\t/// 返回新一层（长度 `ceil(n/2)`）。\n73\tpub fn reduce_level(level_no: u64, nodes: &[Hash32]) -> Vec<Hash32> {\n74\t    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(nodes.len().div_ceil(2));\n75\t    let mut i = 0;\n76\t    while i + 1 < nodes.len() {\n77\t        out.push(hash_pair(level_no, &nodes[i], {"parentUuid":"b323865a-b22e-4dce-b966-e4e5c6600c92","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"text":"我需要彻底冷静地推导，而不是反复横跳。设一层节点按全局索引配对 `(0,1),(2,3),...`，最后一个奇数索引节点提升。\n\n- 左兄弟需求：区间左边界 `lo` 是右孩子 ⟺ `lo` 奇。\n- 右兄弟需求：区间右边界 `hi` 是某对的**左孩子**且该对的右孩子在区间外。左孩子索引为偶，所以 `hi` **偶**，且右孩子 `hi+1` 存在 ⟺ `hi+1 < width` ⟺ `hi < width-1`。\n\n之前两个版本都在边界条件上差一。用 n=4 首块验证：`[0,1)`，hi=1 为奇——但节点1是它的右兄弟！说明“hi 偶”错了。重新想：区间 `[0,1)` 占据节点0，节点0的配对兄弟是节点1（右）。`hi=1` 指向节点1本身，即右孩子索引。所以条件应是 **hi 为奇且 hi<width**（右孩子存在）。这正是证明者最初的版本，也是刚才被我改错的。而 n=5 `[0,5)` 全范围 width=5 时 hi=5、`hi<width=false` 不给右兄弟——正确（提升位）。\n\n真正的问题在**验证者**的前置校验，它与证明者不同步。让我把两边都设回 `hi%2==1 && hi<width` 并仔细查验证者。\n","type":"text"}],"id":"msg_5fd9022c368b7b0d22d539d5","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1367,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":118584,"output_tokens":692,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"apiBlockIndex":1,"type":"assistant","uuid":"684ec63a-a375-49da-bd9f-afeb97576940","timestamp":"2026-09-23T02:10:33.215Z","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"198dca0f-38b8-45f6-b9d3-e2d9ba95a199","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp10/b","sessionId":"198dca0f-38b8-45f6-b9d3-e2d9ba95a199","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp10-b","slug":"giggly-swimming-widget"}

{"parentUuid":"b5e5bac8-5cda-4afc-8567-328a97d73d9a","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_l3iwhy1oaz0ohr4a2cm8m61e","input":{"replace_all":false,"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp10/b/src/merkle.rs","old_string":"    let mut steps: Vec<ProofStep> = Vec::new();\n    let (mut lo, mut hi) = (start, end); // 当前层覆盖区间 [lo, hi)\n    for level_no in 1u64..(levels.len() as u64) {\n        let level = &levels[(level_no - 1) as usize];\n        let width = level.len() as u64;\n\n        // 左邻居：lo 是某双亲的右孩子\n        let left = if lo % 2 == 1 {\n            Some(level[(lo - 1) as usize])\n        } else {\n            None\n        };\n        // 右邻居：hi 为奇数（区间右端是某双亲的左孩子，其右孩子紧随其后），\n        // 且右孩子确实存在（hi < width；奇数提升位时 hi==width 不给右兄弟）\n        let right = if hi % 2 == 1 && hi < width {\n            Some(level[hi as usize])\n        } else {\n            None\n        };\n        steps.push(ProofStep { left, right });\n\n        // 推进到上一层\n        lo = if left.is_some() { lo - 1 } else { lo } / 2;\n        hi = if right.is_some() { hi + 1 } else { hi } / 2;\n\n        // 不能在区间压缩为单个节点时提前停止：奇数提升链下该节点未必是根，\n        // 可能还要在上一层与兄弟归约（如 n=3、区间 [0,1) 时还需与提升的末节点配对）。\n        // 始终走完整棵树的高度（循环本身即遍历到根层）。\n    }","new_string":"    let mut steps: Vec<ProofStep> = Vec::new();\n    let (mut lo, mut hi) = (start, end); 独立校验请求体中的 [`RangeProof`]（不依赖任何仓库/文件） |\n12\t//!\n13\t//! 错误统一为 `{\"error\":\"...\"}` + 非 2xx 状态码。\n14\t\n15\tuse crate::merkle::RangeProof;\n16\tuse crate::store::Repository;\n17\tuse repos: Mutex::new(HashMap::new()),\n37\t        })\n38\t    }\n39\t\n40\t    /// 阻塞监听。\n41\t    pub fn serve(self: &Arc<Self>, addr: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n42\t        std::fs::create_dir_all(&self.data_dir)?;\n43\t        let listener = TcpListener::bind(addr)?;\n44\t        self.serve_listener(listener)\n45\t    }\n46\t\n47\t    /// 在已绑定的 listener 上服务（测试用，避免端口竞争）。\n48\t    pub fn serve_listener(self: &Arc<Self>, listener: TcpListener) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n49\t        let local = listener.local_addr()?;\n50\t        eprintln!(\n51\t            \"imerkle listening on http://{} (data dir: {:?})\",\n52\t            local, self.data_dir\n53\t        );\n54\t        for stream in listener.incoming() {\n55\t            match stream {\n56\t                Ok(s) => {\n57\t                    let server = self.clone();\n58\t                    std::thread::spawn(move || {\n59\t                        let _ = handle_connection(server, s);\n60\t                    });\n61\t                }\n62\t                Err(e) => eprintln!(\"accept error: {e}\"),\n63\t            }\n64\t        }\n65\t        Ok(())\n66\t    }\n67\t\n68\t    fn get_repo(&self, name: &str) -> Option<SharedRepo> {\n69\t        self.repos.lock().unwrap().get(name).cloned()\n70\t    }\n71\t\n72\t    fn open_repo(&self, name: &str, chunk_size: u64) -> Result<SharedRepo, String> {\n73\t        validate_name(name)?;\n74\t        let mut repos = self.repos.lock().unwrap();\n75\t        if let Some(r) = repos.get(name) {\n76\t            return Ok(r.clone());\n77\t        }\n78\t        let dir = self.data_dir.join(name);\n79\t        let vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs> = Arc::new(RealVfs::new(&dir));\n80\t        let repo = Repository::open(vfs, chunk_size).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n81\t        let arc = Arc::new(Mutex::new(repo));\n82\t        repos.insert(name.to_string(), arc.clone());\n83\t        Ok(arc)\n84\t    }\n85\t}\n86\t\n87\tfn validate_name(name: &str) -> Result<(), String> {\n88\t    if name.is_empty()\n89\t        || name.len() > 64\n90\t        || !name\n91\t            .chars()\n92\t            .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '-' || c == '_')\n93\t    {\n94\t        return Err(\"invalid repo name (allowed: A-Z a-z 0-9 - _)\".into());\n95\t    }\n96\t    Ok(())\n97\t}\n98\t\n99\tstruct Request {\n100\t    method: String,\n101\t    path: String,\n102\t    query: String,\n103\t    body: Vec<u8>,\n104\t}\n105\t\n106\tfn read_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<Request> {\n107\t    let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(8192);\n108\t    let mut tmp = [0u8; 4096];\n109\t    // 读到 header 结束\n110\t    let header_end = loop {\n111\t        let n = stream.read(&mut tmp)?;\n112\t        if n == 0 {\n113\t            return Err(std::io::Error::new(\n114\t                std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof,\n115\t                \"empty\",\n116\t            ));\n117\t        }\n118\t        buf.extend_from_slice(&tmp[..n]);\n119\t        if let Some(p) = find_subsequence(&buf, b\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\") {\n120\t            break p;\n121\t        }\n122\t        if buf.len() > 64 * 1024 * 1024 {\n123\t            return Err(std::io::Error::new(\n124\t                std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n125\t                \"header too large\",\n126\t            ));\n127\t        }\n128\t    };\n129\t\n130\t    let header = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..header_end]).to_string();\n131\t    let mut lines = header.split(\"\\r\\n\");\n132\t    let request_line = lines.next().unwrap_or(\"\");\n133\t    let mut parts = request_line.split_whitespace();\n134\t    let method = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"\").to_string();\n135\t    let raw_target = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"\");\n136\t    let (path, query) = match raw_target.split_once('?') {\n137\t        Some((p, q)) => (p.to_string(), q.to_string()),\n138\t        None => (raw_target.to_string(), String::new()),\n139\t    };\n140\t\n141\t    let content_length: usize = lines\n142\t        .find_map(|l| {\n143\t            let (k, v) = l.split_once(':')?;\n144\t            if k.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"content-length\") {\n145\t                v.trim().parse().ok()\n146\t            } else {\n147\t                None\n148\t            }\n149\t        })\n150\t        .unwrap_or(0);\n151\t\n152\t    let mut body = buf[header_end + 4..].to_vec();\n153\t    while body.len() < content_length {\n154\t        let n = stream.read(&mut tmp)?;\n155\t        if n == 0 {\n156\t            break;\n157\t        }\n158\t        body.extend_from_slice(&tmp[..n]);\n159\t    }\n160\t    body.truncate(content_length);\n161\t\n162\t    Ok(Request {\n163\t        method,\n164\t        path,\n165\t        query,\n166\t        body,\n167\t    })\n168\t}\n169\t\n170\tfn find_subsequence(haystack: &[u8], needle: &[u8]) -> Option<usize> {\n171\t    haystack.windows(needle.len()).position(|w| w == needle)\n172\t}\n173\t\n174\tfn query_params(q: &str) -> HashMap<String, out.insert(url_decode(k), url_decode(v));\n179\t        }\n180\t    }\n181\t    out\n182\t}\n183\t\n184\tfn url_decode(s: &str) -> String {\n185\t    let bytes = s.as_bytes();\n186\t    let mut out = I/O 层。\n2\t//!\n3\t//! 存储库逻辑只依赖 [`Vfs`] trait，因此测试中可以：\n4\t//! - 用 [`RealVfs`] 跑真实磁盘（含 fsync 语义）；\n5\t//! - 用带钩子的 [`MemVfs`]（[`MemVfs::with_hook`]）配合 [`FaultPolicy`] 模拟 I/O 错误与\n6\t//!   “断电崩溃”（崩溃 = journal 回到最后 fsync 的长度，其它未 sync 的新块句柄失效），\n7\t//!   验证 WAL 提交边界与崩溃恢复。\n8\t\n9\tuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\n10\tuse std::io::{self, Read, Seek, SeekFrom, Write};\n11\tuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n12\tuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n13\t\n14\t/// 文件句柄抽象（读写、定位、同步）。\n15\tpub trait VfsFile: Read + Write + Seek {\n16\t    fn sync_all(&mut self) -> io::Result<()>;\n17\t    ///
